多智能体系统

[MA-0] Decentralized Bi-Level Optimization for Cooperative Orbital Transportation of a Rigid Payload

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在轨拥挤与空间碎片增加背景下，对大型非合作目标进行可靠在轨运输的挑战。传统单体架构存在单点故障风险，而采用小型航天器编队虽可分散风险并提升系统鲁棒性，但需应对各航天器推力受锥形约束与载荷旋转动力学耦合的非凸轨迹优化问题。现有方法或为分布式控制律（具备渐近稳定性但约束满足能力有限），或为集中式/部分集中式规划（重新引入单点故障隐患）。本文提出一种基于精确梯度的分布式双层优化框架：将原问题分解为内层凸推力分配与外层载荷扭矩轨迹搜索两部分。该分解结构可在不完全收敛于非线性规划（NLP）的情况下快速获得燃料高效解，并在短时间尺度下性能随航天器数量增加而提升。理论分析证明了算法的收敛性，通过大规模蒙特卡洛仿真验证了其有效性，包括飞行中故障的闭环恢复能力。上述特性使该框架特别适用于航天器编队任务中的在轨运输场景。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31562
作者: Sidhdharth D. Sikka,Revathy Ravuri,Hei Yin Jowett Chan,Tim Echtermeyer,Shaoshuai Mou
机构: Purdue University (普渡大学); University of Manchester (曼彻斯特大学); Manifold Research Group (曼德尔研究组)
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The rapid growth of the space economy, alongside increasing orbital congestion and debris, is driving demand for reliable on-orbit transportation of large and non-cooperative objects. Performing such transportation with a swarm of small spacecraft distributes risk and removes the single point of failure inherent to monolithic architectures, but requires solving a non-convex trajectory optimization coupling every agent’s cone-constrained thrust to the payload’s rotational dynamics. Existing approaches span decentralized control laws with asymptotic guarantees but limited constraint enforcement, and centralized and partially centralized planners that reintroduce a single point of failure. In this work, we present a decentralized bi-level framework driven by exact gradients: the problem is split into an inner convex thrust allocation and an outer search over payload torque trajectories. This decomposition yields fuel-efficient solutions quickly, without requiring full NLP convergence, and at short timescales its performance scales with the number of agents. Theoretical convergence guarantees are established, and the method is validated through extensive Monte Carlo simulation, including closed-loop recovery from in-flight faults. These properties make the framework well suited to spacecraft swarm applications.

[MA-1] Contestable Agents for Data Governance: Recording Human Stewardship of AI-Generated Metadata Across Structured and Unstructured Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决工业组织在管理结构化与非结构化运营知识源时面临的治理难题，即传统治理模式依赖少数具备深厚领域知识的员工进行元数据分类、关联与文档化，效率低下且易引入错误。现有基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的智能代理虽可自动提出元数据建议、引用文档并识别质量问题，但未经审核的提议可能将错误传播至下游系统，而简单的审批流程又缺乏可追溯性。为此，论文提出“可争议治理”（contestable governance）机制：由专业领域代理生成带有评分和引用证据的论证，用于支持存在争议的元数据决策；由管理者（steward）在提交前可接受、拒绝、修改或补充论证，确保审查过程透明可追溯；治理记录完整保留所有证据、干预行为与最终结果。同时，通过版本化的领域术语词典（versioned domain glossary）为代理提供模型专用术语与缩写定义，提升准确性。该方案设计了分层审查路径，仅对不确定性高的提案触发完整论证流程，兼顾效率与严谨性，并引入决策门控机制（gate），控制经验证的决策是否成为后续参考先例。两个暖通空调（HVAC）应用场景验证了该方法的有效性：一是利用Brick Schema标签对设备点位进行分类，依托开源参考实现；二是通过链接索赔字段、遥测数据与服务笔记及修订版公告，实现故障模式判定的可解释决策。核心解决方案在于构建一个可审计、可辩论、可追溯的协同治理框架，将生成式人工智能的效率优势与人工专家的判断权威相结合。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31553
作者: Humza Akhtar,Brian Freeman
机构: MongoDB, Inc.(MongoDB公司); Trane Technologies(特耐技术公司)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Databases (cs.DB); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 15 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Industrial organizations hold operational knowledge in structured records, such as telemetry, point lists, and transactions, and in unstructured sources, such as manuals, service notes, communications, and inspection reports. Governance programs often manage these sources separately. Classifying, linking, and documenting them depends on a small group of employees with deep domain knowledge. Agents built on large language models can propose metadata, cite documents, and flag quality issues, but unreviewed proposals can spread errors into downstream systems. A perfunctory approval leaves no record of what a reviewer checked. We present contestable governance: specialist agents produce scored, cited arguments for disputed metadata decisions; a steward can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before commit; and a governance record retains the evidence, interventions, and outcome. A versioned domain glossary supplies model-specific terms and acronym definitions to the agents. We describe the workflow, a triage path that reserves full argumentation for uncertain proposals while preserving review before commit, the scoring and record models, and a gate that controls which verified decisions become precedent. Two HVAC use cases illustrate the pattern: point classification using Brick Schema class labels, supported by an open reference implementation, and an illustrative warranty failure-mode decision linking claim fields and telemetry to service notes and revisioned bulletins.

[MA-2] Dispersive Tree Agreements for Multi-Robot Coordination

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多机器人非线性系统协同控制中难以兼顾联合最优性与分布式实时性的核心挑战。现有方法或为集中式离线优化（仅保证全局最优但缺乏实时响应），或为分布式实时规划（支持安全导航但无法逼近联合最优解），二者在实际应用中存在明显权衡。本文提出的关键解决方案是：通过构建一种基于分散树（dispersive trees）的分布式列生成机制，将原本耦合的多机器人协同问题转化为局部约束下的可并行搜索过程。其核心创新在于证明了机器人间的相互作用可通过局部共享空间的“租金”（rents）进行有效建模，使得各机器人在本地生长分散树时，能通过异步协商机制逐步收敛至近似联合最优的共识解。该方法以“随时可用”（anytime）的方式运行，其协议WarpWeaver在滚动时域框架下实现异步实时迭代，即使在时间预算不足的情况下仍能达成稳定且近优的协调方案。仿真结果表明，相比集中式离线规划器，WarpWeaver在Dynobench基准上可减少22%总行程时间；相较同类分布式实时基线，提升达37%；同时显著提高图连通性任务的成功率。硬件实验在六台机器人上验证了其在机载平台上的可行性，证实了该方法在真实环境中的实用价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31540
作者: Shashank A. Deshpande,Blake T. Edwards,Jonathan P. How
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-robot coordination of nonlinear systems is naturally formulated as joint-space optimal control subject to constraints over groups of robots. Existing methods that approach joint optimality remain largely centralized, offline, and confined to collision-free motion planning, while decentralized, real-time counterparts target safe navigation without pursuing the joint optimum. This paper develops a decentralized, real-time planner that approaches the joint optimum as an anytime process. We extend a recent single-robot framework that searches dispersive trees of forward-propagated commands for differentially flat systems to coordinate a multi-robot team near-optimally. We first show that the inter-robot coupling can be effectively replaced by some local constraints, under which locally grown dispersive trees contain a near-optimal agreement. It is this structure that the robots pursue by decentralized column generation, negotiating rents on the shared space that guide the search of each robot’s tree. The negotiation settles on an agreement whose near-optimality is certified at quiescence. Our protocol, WarpWeaver, implements this negotiation as an asynchronous real-time loop over a receding horizon, and demonstrates effective closure to quiesced agreements even when real-time deadlines cut the negotiation short. In simulation, WarpWeaver reduces total travel time by up to 22% against centralized offline planners on the Dynobench suite and by up to 37% against a decentralized real-time baseline, and nearly doubles the success rate of a task-specific planner on graph connectivity. Hardware experiments on six robots planning onboard demonstrate real-world implementability.

[MA-3] When Is a Memory Safe Enough to Act On? Action-Conditioned Verification for Long-Lived Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决长期智能体（long-lived agents）在跨会话执行中因记忆过时而导致不可逆错误行为的问题。现有方法仅关注记忆本身的维护（如检索、刷新或调和），但未考虑不同动作对记忆验证需求的差异：同一记忆条目在常规运输中可直接使用，而在高价值操作前则需重新确认。为此，论文提出动作条件化记忆验证（action-conditioned memory verification）机制，其核心在于根据候选动作的性质动态决定哪些记忆前提需要重验、何时执行或放弃行动，以权衡执行风险、弃用代价与验证成本。作者将此问题建模为一个序贯停止问题（sequential stopping problem），其中验证只有在可能改变后续决策时才具有价值；在验证器可靠性与成本满足一定条件时，随着动作后果严重性增加，相同记忆可依次进入“直接执行”、“验证后执行”和“直接弃用”三种策略模式。基于该理论框架，研究提出了名为 \textscAMV-Guard 的实用验证门控系统，其通过提取动作依赖的记忆前提、校准对错误可能性的信念，并采用有界信息价值（bounded Value of Information, VOI）选择验证项。在 ToolSandbox 上，相较于静态策略，\textscAMV-Guard 在保持 100% 安全执行召回率和 0% 有害行为的前提下，平均验证成本降低 33.9%，且执行覆盖率从 38.83% 提升至 44.17%；在 AppWorld 的门控核心迁移实验中，验证成本降低 21.3%，同时仅轻微影响安全执行召回率与任务成功率。结果表明，验证资源的分配应由即将执行的动作所决定，而非仅依赖记忆本身的可信度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31446
作者: Yiqi Wang,Yifei Wang,Jiaqi Zhang,Zhangkai Wu,Yiqun Duan,Taotao Cai,Mingkai Zheng
机构: University of Southern Queensland (南昆士兰大学); Southern University of Science and Technology (南方科技大学); Jiangsu University (江苏大学); The University of Sydney (悉尼大学); Uploading Inc. (上传公司)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 22 Pages, 5 Figures, 12 Tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-lived agents act on memory carried across sessions, and many of their actions are irreversible, so a stale memory can turn directly into harm. Existing work improves the memory itself — retrieving, refreshing, or reconciling entries — yet whether an entry must be re-checked before acting is not a property of the entry: the same remembered address can be used unchecked for a routine shipment but should be re-confirmed before a valuable one. We therefore study \emphaction-conditioned memory verification: given a candidate action, decide which of its memory premises to re-verify and when to proceed or abstain, balancing execution risk, abstention, and verification cost. We formulate this as a sequential stopping problem, in which a verification is worth its cost only if it can change what the agent does next; under suitable verifier reliability and cost conditions, increasing action consequence can move the same memory through proceed, verify, and direct-abstention regimes. Building on this formulation, \textscAMV-Guard is a practical verification gate that extracts the premises a candidate action rests on, calibrates beliefs about whether they are wrong, and selects checks by bounded value of information (VOI). On ToolSandbox, relative to a static policy given the same inputs, it lowers mean verification cost by 33.9% while keeping 100% safe-proceed recall and 0% Gate harmful, and raises Proceed coverage from 38.83% to 44.17%; in a gate-core transfer to AppWorld, which carries over the stopping/VOI core but not the full structured pipeline, it lowers verification cost by 21.3% at a small cost in safe-proceed recall and task success. These results suggest that verification effort should be set by what an agent is about to do, not only by how reliable a memory appears.

[MA-4] Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自动化智能体系统（agentic system）在实际部署中面临的动态环境挑战，包括持续的分布外（out-of-distribution）变化、延迟的依赖性反馈、组件故障的关联性以及架构变更的成本高昂等问题。传统评估方法依赖静态任务集与即时标量奖励，无法反映真实场景中的复杂性。为此，论文将元智能体架构搜索形式化为带有切换成本和硬风险约束的序列型现有架构替换问题，并提出保守型元智能体搜索（Conservative Meta-Agent Search, CMAS）。CMAS的关键在于：通过回溯历史架构并提议类型化的图结构修改，利用相同随机数下的成对影子回放（paired shadow replay）结合干预性组件归因（interventional component credit）对候选架构进行评分；仅当其得分在经验校准的方差惩罚下同时超过预设阈值时才允许晋升，并随后引入模拟“金丝雀”阶段与预设回滚机制以保障安全性。为验证元层级泛化能力，研究构建了MetaInvest-Bench——一个具有制度切换特性的仿真器，支持可计算的近似最优架构，具备防泄漏回放、对抗性治理轨迹及五种负向控制。实验表明，在96条金融流上，CMAS将归约于动态或然最优解的标准化均值后悔率从0.116降至0.104，同时提升保留样本效用至0.48（优于最强自适应基线），且在冗余工作者无增益时能自动收缩为接近单智能体团队的轻量结构。尽管其部署推理开销降低约6%，但包含搜索过程的总令牌消耗为各方法中最高。观测到的每轮更新虚假晋升率为3.4%（目标5%），密封重跑下为4.8%，校准基于作者设计基准上的更新级回放统计，不保证整体效用提升、模拟金丝雀阶段无害性，亦不提供序列级错误控制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31436
作者: Ali Atiah Alzahrani
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 24 pages, 8 figures, 17 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated agentic-system design is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers, with interventional component credit. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Since backtests cannot certify meta-level skill, we introduce MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence makes a surrogate-optimal architecture computable, with leakage-controlled replay, adversarial governance tracks, and five negative controls. Financial streams serve as a risk-sensitive testbed for meta-level generalization; we claim no alpha. Across 96 streams, CMAS cuts normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive baseline; when extra workers add no value, it contracts to near-single-agent teams. Its deployment inference cost is ~6% lower, though its search-inclusive token cost is the highest of the methods compared. The observed per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun. The calibration is empirical: it concerns an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark, and guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control.

[MA-5] Probabilistic Energy Modeling Unifies Versatile Swarm Control

【速读】：该论文旨在解决机器人集群在面对多样化任务时，现有控制器需频繁重新设计、调参或重新训练的局限性问题。其核心挑战在于如何实现跨任务、跨规模与跨平台的高效泛化控制。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于概率能量建模（probabilistic energy modeling）的统一框架，将多种集群行为抽象为可复用的能量项（energy terms），通过组合这些共享的交互原则来生成多样化的任务目标，而非依赖于特定任务的控制策略。该方法利用吉布斯随机场（Gibbs random field）能量最小化与结构化奖励最大化之间的对应关系，在统一的概率目标函数中整合基础行为模式。通过轻量级策略门控（policy gating）机制将分布式策略集成至单一控制器，无需重新训练；引入可解释的动作注意力机制以捕捉非均匀局部交互，并采用无量纲归一化实现跨集群规模与硬件平台的迁移。实验表明，该统一策略在六类任务、10–100个智能体、两种真实硬件平台以及室内外复杂环境中均实现了零样本迁移（zero-shot transfer），大规模仿真中任务成功率高达0.96–1.00，单智能体推理延迟仅为1–10毫秒，物理部署亦验证了其在真实场景下的有效性。这确立了概率能量建模作为可扩展、可迁移的去中心化集群控制新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31371
作者: Xiang Zhou,Xiangyu Zhu,Xintong Wang,Qingyuan Yang,Rui Huang,Feng Xue,Lin Li,Qingrui Zhang
机构: Sun Yat-sen University (中山大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 25

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Robotic swarms must coordinate across diverse missions, yet existing controllers often require redesign, retuning, or retraining when objectives change. Here we show that probabilistic energy modeling provides a unifying representation for versatile swarm control, in which diverse missions emerge from compositions of shared interaction principles rather than task-specific control formulations. By exploiting the correspondence between Gibbs random field energy minimization and structured reward maximization, we encode fundamental swarm behaviors as reusable energy terms within a unified probabilistic objective. Decentralized policies trained within this representation are composed into a single controller through lightweight policy gating, without retraining. An interpretable action-attention mechanism captures non-uniform local interactions, while dimensionless normalization supports transfer across swarm scales and platforms. Demonstrated on aerial swarms, the unified policy generalizes zero-shot across six mission classes, 10-100 agents, two hardware platforms, and indoor cluttered and GPS-denied woodland environments. Large-scale simulations achieve 0.96-1.00 task success rates with 1-10 ms per-agent inference latency, while physical deployments confirm zero-shot transfer to real platforms and unstructured environments. These results establish probabilistic energy modeling as a scalable and transferable framework for decentralized swarm control.

[MA-6] Muffin - A Shared Memory Buffer for Asynchronous AI Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前目标驱动型推理任务中，单智能体与多智能体系统在性能提升上趋于持平的问题，其核心挑战在于智能体间交互与协调过程中关键信息传递效率低下。现有基于同步轮次辩论的多智能体范式依赖于各智能体间的显式信息共享，易导致通信开销大且效率受限。为此，本文提出一种基于共享记忆缓冲区推理（Memory Buffer Inference, MUFFIN）的异步智能体交互协议，通过引入一个由编排器（orchestrator）动态调度查询、将复杂任务分配至多智能体环境的机制，在保证各智能体本地私有推理独立性的同时，利用共享记忆缓冲区实现异步的中间结果交换。实验表明，MUFFIN框架在20个基准测试中的17个场景下达到最优准确率，相较主流多智能体辩论方法，准确率提升19.2个百分点，同时减少77.4%的令牌消耗，且无需完整推理轨迹共享，显著优化了性能与成本之间的权衡。

Abstract:The rise of Agentic AI systems has changed the landscape of artificial intelligence by enabling strong reasoning capabilities through specialized multi-agent interaction with structured self-reflection. However, in target-driven reasoning tasks, single- and multi-agent systems are often on par in terms of performance gains. A major challenge is that failures often arise from an ineffective exchange of critical information during inter-agent interaction and coordination. Different from existing multi-agent debate paradigms that rely on synchronous turn-taking and sharing information across different agents, we propose an inter-agent protocol based on shared Memory bUFFer INference - referred to as MUFFIN - in an asynchronous agentic framework. In the first step, an orchestrator routes queries based on their reasoning demands and delegates demanding ones to a multi-agent setting, where a shared memory buffer provides asynchronous exchange of intermediate findings while an agent’s private reasoning remains local. Our experiments show that our framework Muffin outperforms established competitors, achieving the best accuracy in 17 out of 20 of our benchmark settings, and provides a better quality-cost trade-off than multi-agent debate: Muffin improves accuracy by 19.2 accuracy points while using 77.4% fewer tokens, without requiring full-trace sharing.

[MA-7] Automating Feature Flag Cleanup at Scale with Multi-Agent LLM Systems: An Industrial Experience at DoorDash

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模软件系统中因长期未清理的特性开关（feature flag）所引发的技术债务与运维风险问题。随着特性逐步上线，已完全发布的功能所对应的开关及其代码路径若未及时移除，将导致冗余代码积累，增加系统复杂性并可能在无意中激活潜在错误路径。在DoorDash的实际场景中，超过56,000个特性开关分布在623个代码仓库中，截至2026年5月已有1,659个处于“过期”（stale）状态，且手动清理每个开关平均耗时1至2小时，现有基于规则的自动化工具难以有效应对这一挑战。本文提出一种端到端的基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的特性开关自动清理系统，其核心创新在于集成多源数据：通过MCP（Model-Driven Configuration Protocol）查询实时特性发布数据、解析Jira工单以获取上下文依据，并自动生成经工程师审核的拉取请求（Pull Request）。评估结果显示，该系统在50个过期开关上的测试中成功生成了45个（90%）可被工程师批准的删除拉取请求，平均每次清理耗时仅4.79至13.8分钟，验证了其在大规模生产环境中的可行性与高效性。此外，研究还通过成功率、清理成本及时间等指标评估了系统的质量与可靠性边界，并总结了构建此类多智能体系统的关键经验，为同类系统的开发提供了实践指导。

Abstract:Feature flags are runtime configuration mechanisms used for gradual feature rollouts, experimentation, and kill switches. Once a feature is fully rolled out, the flag and its gated code become technical debt and can introduce operational risk through inadvertently enabling dormant code paths. At DoorDash, over 56,000 feature flags span 623 repositories, with 1,659 currently stale as of May 2026, with internal estimates of one to two hours per manual cleanup. Existing rule-based cleanup tools proved insufficient in DoorDash’s codebases. Our contribution is an end-to-end automated LLM-based feature flag cleanup system that integrates querying live feature flag rollout data using MCP, Jira ticket processing, and end-to-end pull request creation. Our system successfully produced engineer-approved flag removal PRs for 45 (90%) of the 50 stale flags it was evaluated on, proving the system’s operational viability at scale with each cleanup averaging only 4.79 and 13.8 minutes. We evaluated the system’s quality and reliability boundary based on success rates, cost per cleanup and time metrics. Furthermore, we discuss our lessons learned when architecting this system, to provide practical guidance for developing similar multi-agent systems.

[MA-8] Consistent but Biased: Chair Personas Trade Noise for Bias in Multi-Agent Clinical Decisions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在由多个大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理组成的临床决策系统中，主导代理（即“主席”代理）的个性提示（persona prompt）是否影响最终决策，以及这种变化是否仅影响决策时间而非实质内容的问题。现有系统常将多次运行结果的一致性视为可靠性指标，但未在保持病例不变的前提下检验这一假设。研究通过模拟一个由七名代理组成的虚拟科室，对20例退行性颈椎脊髓病（degenerative cervical myelopathy）的真实病例进行重复测试，固定病例报告不变，仅改变主席及其副手的提示类型：包括无个性提示、咨询型、专断型和回避型，且以行为规则或人格特质两种方式呈现。结果显示，当采用规则形式的提示时，专断型人格使手术决策立即执行的比例高达93%，而回避型则降至2%，相比之下无特定人格提示时为57%；尽管所有情况下均倾向手术，但人格提示主要影响的是“立即手术”还是“延迟观察”的决策时机。该效应在另一模型及重述提示后仍可复现。进一步分析表明，专断与回避人格虽提升了三轮运行间的一致性，但其一致性水平接近随机预期，且弗莱斯kappa值（Fleiss κ）未显著提升，说明所谓“一致性”并非真正可靠。值得注意的是，仅描述人格特质的提示仍保留了超过一半的专断与回避型行为影响，表现为快速决策、延迟行动及增加检查，但未能再现忽略警示信号、放弃备选方案或转交家庭决策等更深层次行为。因此，该研究的关键结论是：必须将主席代理的个性提示作为关键变量加以报告与控制，并在评估运行一致性时校正随机一致性的基准，否则易误判为可靠性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In clinical systems built from several large language model (LLM) agents, one agent often chairs the discussion and makes the final decision. Whether the chair’s persona prompt changes that decision, or the agreement between repeated runs that some systems treat as reliability, has not been tested with the case held constant. We ask whether the persona changes the decision or only its timing, how it affects agreement between runs, and which behaviors appear when the prompt describes only personality traits. A simulated department of seven agents discussed 20 published cases of degenerative cervical myelopathy, with the case reports replayed unchanged in every run. Only the prompts of the chair and its deputy changed (no persona, or a consultative, autocratic or avoidant one), written either as rules of conduct or as personality traits. With personas written as rules, the chair chose to operate now in 93% of runs when autocratic and in 2% when avoidant, against 57% without a persona. Surgery was still planned in nearly all decisions, so the personas mainly changed whether to operate now or after more tests. These effects held with a second model and reworded prompts. The autocratic and avoidant personas made the three runs of a case agree more often, but only about as often as chance predicts, and Fleiss \kappa did not rise. Prompts that described only personality traits kept more than half of the autocratic and avoidant effects on operating now. They reproduced quick decisions, delays and extra tests, but not ignoring red flags, dropping backup plans or passing the decision to the family. Studies should report and vary the chair’s persona as they do the model, and correct agreement between runs for chance before calling it reliability.

Abstract:Existing agricultural advisories to farmers suffer from several limitations: (a) remain largely expert-driven, (b) do not adequately account for in-season weather, and © do not scale to individual farms. In this paper, our objective is to close these gaps by developing Agri-SCHOLAR (Simulation-Grounded Crop Harvest Optimization with LLM-Guided In-Season Advisory Rollouts). Agri-SCHOLAR is a rolling, in-season advisory framework that issues, at intervals of every few days or every week, a personalized advisory using the following information: soil and crop properties, observed weather to date, short-range forecast of weather, and a season extrapolation of weather based on historical analogs. The novelty and depth of Agri-SCHOLAR lies in each advisory being produced by a closed-loop system which couples multiple LLM agents with a powerful crop simulator (such as APSIM in our case). The simulator crucially serves as an evaluation oracle. In Agri-SCHOLAR, the LLM agents propose agronomically sound and feasible bounds on actionable parameters and an optimizer searches within those bounds against a multi-objective reward spanning yield, resource utilization, and economic feasibility. We conduct a detailed 11-year analysis of the maize crop in two selected locations of South Asia and show that Agri-SCHOLAR consistently outperforms the region’s standard packages of practice and satisfactorily addresses the limitations of existing agricultural advisories.

Abstract:This paper investigates consensus-based distributed filtering strategies for multi-observer angles-only navigation in the cislunar space. The objective is to estimate the inertial state of a target spacecraft using only line-of-sight measurements collected by a network of observer spacecraft. This problem is particularly relevant for autonomous cislunar navigation, where ground support may be limited, and centralized fusion architectures may be problematic due to communication and computational constraints, and single-point failure risks. Three distributed filtering approaches are considered: the Distributed Extended Kalman Filter, the Information-Weighted Consensus Filter, and the Kalman Consensus Filter. All methods share the same local prediction and measurement-processing steps, but differ in the way information is exchanged and fused across the network. Their performance is evaluated and compared to a centralized Extended Kalman Filter, adopted as benchmark, and independent local filters in a high-fidelity cislunar scenario. Numerical simulations show that the distributed approaches significantly improve estimation accuracy with respect to independent filters. Monte Carlo sensitivity analyses are then conducted to characterize the robustness of the considered methods to finite consensus iterations and prior misalignment among the agents.

[MA-11] ADAPT for Science: A Multi-Agent System for Self-Evolving Scientific Optimization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决科学发现中在高维、受限搜索空间内高效识别少数高性能设计的难题，尤其针对评估成本高昂、可行解稀疏、参数强耦合及物理约束严格等挑战。传统通用型人工智能优化方法缺乏对科学先验知识、物理约束和有限评估预算的针对性设计。为此，本文提出面向科学的多智能体框架ADAPT for Science，其核心在于将科学优化建模为“何处搜索”与“如何搜索”两个耦合决策过程：通过历史设计数据挖掘具有前景且多样性的初始条件，逐步聚焦计算资源于有利的搜索方向，并基于执行反馈动态演化优化策略。该方法在引力波探测器设计任务中，结合可微分物理仿真器与八种未见过的拓扑结构进行验证，在相同评估预算下实现均方损失0.204 ± 0.101，相较最优经典优化器降低54.9%，相较最优通用代理演化基线降低62.2%，并在所有未见拓扑上均取得最低损失。ADAPT的关键创新在于构建了一个能够持续从过往经验与自身搜索结果中学习的科学优化系统，显著提升了复杂科学问题下的优化效率与泛化能力。

Abstract:Scientific discovery often requires identifying a small number of high-performing designs in vast, constrained search spaces. This is difficult when evaluations are costly, feasible solutions are sparse, parameters are strongly coupled, and physical constraints are strict. Recent AI for AI methods can automatically improve algorithms and optimization procedures. However, general purpose approaches are not designed around scientific priors, physical constraints, and limited evaluation budgets. We introduce ADAPT for Science, a multi-agent framework that treats scientific optimization as two coupled decisions: where to search and how to search. ADAPT uses historical designs to identify promising and diverse initial conditions, progressively concentrates computation on favorable search directions, and evolves the optimization procedure from execution feedback. We evaluate ADAPT on the design of gravitational wave detectors using a differentiable physics simulator and eight unseen detector topologies. Under matched scientific evaluation budgets, ADAPT achieves a mean loss of 0.204 +/- 0.101, reducing loss by 54.9% relative to the best classical optimizer and by 62.2% relative to the best general purpose agentic evolution baseline. ADAPT achieves the lowest loss on all unseen topologies among the evaluated baselines. ADAPT provides a step toward scientific optimization systems that continuously learn from prior experience and their own search outcomes.

[MA-12] ABRA: Agent -Bound UI for Human-Agent Communication beyond Chat with Reusable Views EMNLP2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前智能代理（Agent）虽能生成丰富的上下文表示，但这些表示极少被用作表达用户意图的媒介这一关键问题。其核心挑战在于如何实现任务间可复用的交互结构与具体任务语义之间的解耦，以支持多任务场景下的动态协作。解决方案的关键是提出“代理绑定用户界面”（Agent-Bound UI, ABUI）交互模型，通过将任务特定的语义绑定至可复用的交互视图中，并将其作为共享状态发布，从而使得人与代理能够在共享的交互表面（如交互画布）上理解并响应不同任务背景下的动态语义。为验证该模型，作者实现了无需依赖特定框架的原型系统ABRA，支持用户与代理通过聊天及共享交互画布协同工作，并在画布创作、所有者侧后果处理及跨代理调用等任务上对四个基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理进行了评估，证明了该方法的有效性与普适性。

Abstract:Agents can create rich representations, yet these representations are rarely used as a medium for expressing user intent. We present Agent-Bound UI, an interaction model that separates reusable interaction structures from task-specific meanings. Agents bind task-specific meanings to interactions in reusable views and publish the resulting bindings as shared state, enabling humans and agents to understand and act on shared surfaces whose meanings vary across tasks. We implement ABRA, a framework-agnostic prototype of Agent-Bound UI, in which users and agents collaborate through chat and shared interactive canvases. We demonstrate ABRA through a representative use case and evaluate four LLM-backed agents on canvas authoring, owner-side consequence resolution, and cross-agent invocation. The code and demo video are available at this https URL.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在多智能体系统中协作时，因相互响应他人选择而引发的内生反馈循环所导致的社会性影响、从众行为及失控级联现象等潜在风险。其核心解决方案的关键在于通过类比经典的音乐实验室（Music Lab）实验范式，构建大规模LLM智能体群体进行陌生歌曲推荐任务，并对比在有无累积推荐次数暴露条件下的集体决策表现。实验发现，当智能体暴露于累计推荐数据后，会迅速产生失控级联效应，导致集体推荐结果严重偏离歌曲本身的真实吸引力，且表现出远高于人类的从众倾向，同时缺乏自我校正能力。这一发现揭示了多智能体系统在推荐系统、自动化评估、复杂问题求解及非法共谋等场景中存在显著脆弱性，强调需在系统设计中引入抗干扰机制以抑制非理性集体行为。

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate in multi-agent systems where they collaborate by responding to others’ choices, creating endogenous feedback loops with vulnerability to social influence, herding behavior and runaway cascades. Following the design of the classic Music Lab experiment, we tested this vulnerability in large populations of LLM agents that recommended unfamiliar songs, with or without exposure to cumulative recommendation counts. Exposure led to runaway cascades that generated extreme and unpredictable collective recommendations increasingly divergent from a song’s intrinsic appeal. Compared to humans, LLM populations were generally far more susceptible to herding behavior, and unlike humans, LLM cascades were less able to self-correct. This vulnerability has implications for multi-agent collaboration in recommender systems, automated evaluation, complex problem-solving, and unauthorized conspiracies.

[MA-14] Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在实时网络数据环境下进行自主投资时面临的三大核心挑战：异构证据融合、历史行为记忆以及基于结果的自我改进，同时确保不削弱系统自身的安全约束。其关键解决方案在于构建一个具有类型系统边界控制的多智能体架构——Steward，通过三重机制实现安全且可演化的自主决策：首先，九个角色专精的智能体协同工作，包括四类分析师分别处理新闻、财报、宏观经济与市场数据，并生成带类型的报告，由投资组合经理设定目标仓位，再经受保护的风险管理器审计；其次，七层共享记忆系统通过系统自身记录代码构建，为每个决策提供市场叙事、校准信息及历史决策上下文；最后，系统通过“回顾-评估-学习”闭环实现自我优化：每日对交易与预测进行代码化评分并写入记忆，每季度由反思者提出提示学习，经确定性门控可逆执行，并通过回放历史输入验证有效性。整个系统以“订单算术、风险规则和纪律性提示”为核心不变量，任何自修改都无法触及。实验表明，在5个月真实部署中，系统将24.6%的行业回撤控制在0.3%损失以内；在相同数据下，单一模型五日内相对市场亏损1.35点，而联合设计无显著损失，且未响应任何注入指令；2015–2026年回测显示，仅核心机制即可在全部50种随机入场策略下降低最大回撤。反思模块成功定位根本故障原因，门控机制在触发日实现学习采纳，而在对照日保持静默。

Abstract:LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system’s own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent’s past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades into memory, and each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and replay of recorded inputs verifies. All three operate around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline-agent prompts that no self-edit can reach. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; in replay of its recorded inputs, a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss, and no injected instruction was followed; and a 2015-2026 backtest shows the core alone lowering the maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause, and the gate applied a learning that the agent adopted on trigger evenings and on no control evening. Code: this https URL

[MA-15] Beyond End-to-End Recovery: Towards a Better Understanding of LLM Steganography via Rolewise Decomposition

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）隐写术中因端到端（End-to-End, E2E）恢复评估方法局限性所导致的安全隐患识别不充分问题。传统E2E恢复仅衡量解码器能否正确重建私密信息，无法区分编码失败与解码失败，亦难以揭示私密信息在编码器输出文本中的具体表征方式。为此，论文提出一种分角色分解框架（rolewise decomposition framework），分别分析私密信息在编码器生成文本中的表示形式、解码器实际恢复的内容以及确定性验证可识别的编码模式。通过对7,200条编码器响应的分析，研究发现存在168个可验证但被解码器遗漏的编码实例，以及706个通过词长或标记首字符等未明确指示的模式实现信息重构的响应。这些结果表明，仅依赖E2E恢复可能掩盖编码与解码过程中的关键差异，因此必须对二者进行独立评估，以更准确理解并缓解由LLM隐写术引发的安全风险。

作者: Om Tailor,Yucheng Pan,Solaleh Mohammadi,Xinyan Liu,Kaiqing Zhang
机构: University of Maryland, College Park (马里兰大学学院公园分校)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 33 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In large language model (LLM) steganography, an encoder hides a private message in an otherwise ordinary response, as text transmitted to a decoder, who attempts to recover it. The success of this private-message transmission is commonly measured through end-to-end (E2E) recovery, which checks whether the decoder correctly reconstructs the private message. However, E2E recovery cannot distinguish encoding failures from decoding failures or reveal how the private message is represented in the encoder’s transmitted text. To address these limitations, we introduce a rolewise decomposition framework that separately examines how private messages are represented in encoder transmitted texts, what decoders recover, and what deterministic verification can establish. Across 7,200 encoder responses, we identify 168 verifiable encodings missed by decoders and 706 responses containing private messages reconstructed through word-length or token-initial patterns not explicitly specified in the encoder’s instructions. These findings demonstrate that E2E recovery alone may obscure important distinctions between encoding and decoding, motivating their separate evaluation to better understand and mitigate the safety issues caused by LLM steganography.

[MA-16] Learning to Incentivise: Using Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable Urban Mobility

【速读】：该论文旨在解决传统交通管理中依赖收费与道路定价机制所引发的可及性争议及公众不满问题，尤其针对如芬兰等地因社会接受度低而禁止道路定价的现实困境。其核心问题是如何在不依赖直接收费的前提下，通过动态激励机制引导驾驶员主动选择替代路径，从而实现交通网络整体效率提升与环境效益优化。解决方案的关键在于采用多智能体强化学习（multi-agent reinforcement learning）框架，动态分配激励以协同优化总出行时间（Total Travel Time, TTT）与总碳排放量，利用交通仿真软件实时估算行程时间，并基于多目标加权函数平衡二者之间的权衡关系。研究结果表明，在预算无限且以最小化TTT为目标时，激励方案可使TTT降低16%；当目标转向减排时，CO₂排放减少9%；更重要的是，通过合理设置多目标权重，可在不牺牲任一指标的前提下同时优于基线水平，有效破解“时间-排放”间的固有矛盾，为可持续城市交通管理提供了可扩展的智能化决策支持。

Abstract:Traffic management has traditionally focused on toll-based and road pricing solutions. However, road pricing often raises concerns about accessibility and public dissatisfaction, leading to its prohibition in some places, such as Finland. This study optimises the dynamic allocation of incentives to drivers, encouraging them to reroute onto alternative (potentially longer) paths to achieve greater societal benefit, reduced total travel time (TTT) and total emissions in the transportation network, contributing to sustainable urban mobility. We employ a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach to dynamically assign incentives to drivers to reduce both TTT and emissions, with travel times estimated using traffic simulation software. We demonstrate that, with an unlimited budget and an objective of minimising travel time, the incentive scheme reduces TTT by 16%, compared to the dynamic User-Equilibrium (UE) with a budget equivalent to about 11% of the UE total time. When the goal is to minimise emissions, a 9% reduction in CO2 emissions is observed under an unlimited budget. We demonstrate a critical trade-off: minimising TTT leads to an increase in emissions, while prioritising emission reductions raises TTT. However, with the right combination of weights in the multi-objective function, both TTT and total emissions are improved beyond the baseline.

[MA-17] Agent ic Architecture of Information Systems. The AAM/5C Model: A Reference Model for Distributed Autonomy

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大型组织在面对数百个相互依赖组件时所遭遇的“认知复杂性壁垒”问题，即人类团队难以在如此规模下维持依赖关系图谱并以事件响应速度作出及时反应。其解决方案的核心在于提出AAM/5C框架，通过在七个逻辑层级（L1–L7）中实现五项核心能力（捕获、理解、选择、协调、控制），并基于单一授权规则R-AUT构建分权机制：概率规划器（L4）提出行动建议，治理层（L6）在签名策略下决策并生成带签名的评估证明，安全层（L5）据此颁发与该证明绑定的短期执行令牌，策略执行点在目标层实施动作前验证双重凭证。该设计通过显式保证契约确保两个关键假设（H7a, H8a）可构造性成立，其余八个假设（如日志完整性H7b、执行点不可绕过性H8b）虽可被证伪，但其反例协议在测量前已预先确定。该研究的贡献在于提出一种规范性参考模型，整合现有机制并引入三项待验证的新构念——分布式自主循环中的验证步骤、瞬态权限面及认知依赖平面，并与自适应计算、多智能体系统、企业架构及智能体协议（MCP、A2A）进行对比，提供Regos语言编写的授权策略与部分TLA+形式化共识规范，设定量化验证里程碑，但未报告实证结果。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large organizations increasingly face what this book calls the cognitive complexity wall: at the scale of hundreds of interacting components, maintaining the dependency map and reacting at the pace of incidents exceeds what a human team can deliver. This conceptual volume proposes AAM/5C, in which five capabilities (Capture, Comprehend, Choose, Coordinate, Control) are instantiated across seven logical layers, L1 to L7. A single authorization rule, R-AUT, separates who proposes, who decides and who executes: a probabilistic planner (L4) proposes; a governance layer (L6) decides under signed policies and records its verdict in a signed evaluation proof; a security layer (L5) issues a short-lived act token bound to that proof; a policy enforcement point verifies both before the target layer materializes the act. Under an explicit guarantee contract, two analytical statements (H7a, H8a) hold by construction. The other statements of its ten hypotheses (H1 to H10), including log completeness (H7b) and non-bypass of the enforcement point (H8b), are refutable, and the protocol that could refute them is fixed before any measurement. The contribution of the book is a prescriptive reference model that articulates, under this single authorization rule, known mechanisms and adds three constructs, all to be validated: the Validation step of the Distributed Autonomy Loop, the ephemeral authority surface and the cognitive dependency plane. The book positions them against autonomic computing, multi-agent systems, enterprise architecture and agent protocols (MCP, A2A), gives an authorization policy in Rego and a partial TLA+ specification of peer consensus, and sets out a validation program with quantified milestones. It reports no empirical results. This English edition is a translation of the French original, produced with the assistance of AI tools and validated by the author.

[MA-18] Consensus-Aware Co-design of Wireless Multi-Agent Control and Communication Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自主多智能体控制系统（MACS）与无线通信系统之间因设计脱节而导致的性能瓶颈问题：传统MACS设计忽略通信与控制子系统的交互影响，而传统无线资源分配则基于最坏情况下的MACS需求预留资源，造成控制性能下降和无线资源利用效率低下。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种共识感知的协同设计方法，通过构建基于设备到设备（D2D）通信共享蜂窝频谱的系统模型，将智能体间通过有限带宽资源实现一致性（consensus）的过程纳入联合优化框架。具体地，该方法以最小化带宽消耗为目标，联合优化一致性拓扑选择与无线资源分配，同时保障多智能体控制系统的收敛性及蜂窝用户的服务质量（QoS）。尽管该问题为典型的混合整数非线性规划（NP-hard），但其最优解具有可分解的结构特性，从而支持一种具有多项式复杂度的两阶段顺序优化算法。仿真结果表明，在智能电网场景下，所提方法相较两种基线方案可实现24%-27%的带宽节省，同时确保一致性达成并满足所有控制与通信用户的QoS要求。

Abstract:Autonomous multi-agent control systems (MACSs) enable distributed coordination in emerging applications such as smart power grids and autonomous vehicle or drone networks. In many of these applications, inter-agent communication relies on wireless networks. However, conventional MACS designs neglect the interaction between the communication and control subsystems. At the same time, conventional wireless designs reserve communication resources based on worst-case MACS requirements. Consequently, control performance is degraded and wireless resources are utilized inefficiently. To address these challenges, we propose a consensus-aware co-design approach for MACSs and wireless communication systems. We introduce a system model in which agents achieve consensus by exchanging information through device-to-device (D2D) links that share spectrum with cellular users under limited bandwidth resources. Based on this model, we formulate a joint optimization problem for consensus-topology selection and wireless resource allocation to minimize bandwidth consumption while guaranteeing consensus and satisfying the quality-of-service (QoS) requirements of both MACSs and cellular users. Although the resulting problem is a mixed-integer nonlinear program (NP-hard in general), a structural property of the optimal solution enables a sequential two-stage optimization algorithm with polynomial complexity. Simulations on a smart power grid case study demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves 24-27% bandwidth savings compared with the two baselines while maintaining consensus and satisfying all QoS requirements of the control agents and the communication users.

[NLP-0] Direct Pass@k Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理模型在测试时缩放（test-time scaling）过程中，如何高效筛选候选解池以平衡高质量与多样性之间的权衡问题。现有剪枝策略主要分为基于质量的方法（仅保留预测最终结果正确的部分解）和基于多样性的方法（选择遵循不同推理路径的部分解），但二者常存在探索与利用之间的冲突，且缺乏对这一权衡的显式建模。本文提出一种直接优化 pass@k 指标的剪枝方法，其核心在于选择一个部分解集合，以最大化至少有一个解在完整生成后得到正确答案的概率。该目标函数天然地同时奖励高质量的部分解并惩罚解之间的冗余性，从而无需额外的人工设计即可实现质量与多样性的自适应平衡。在八种开源推理模型上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有的质量或多样性导向剪枝策略，尤其在保留中等数量部分解时性能提升最为明显，验证了直接建模质量-多样性权衡的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31667
作者: Mahdi Salmani,Adel Javanmard,Devansh Gupta,Meisam Razaviyayn
机构: University of Southern California
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@ k over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.

[NLP-1] Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM -Based IT Ticket Classification ICTAI2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决IT支持工单自动路由中因错误分配而导致的高成本问题，尤其关注在缺乏明确分类置信度时，如何通过成本感知的拒答（cost-aware abstention）机制降低整体处理成本。其核心解决方案的关键在于：在离线阶段基于校准数据显式定义成本函数（如正确路由成本 cok=0c_{ok}=0cok​=0、人工转派成本 ctriage=1c_{triage}=1ctriage​=1、错误路由成本 cwrong=5c_{wrong}=5cwrong​=5），选择并冻结一个最优路由策略（如使用TF-IDF与逻辑回归结合阈值0.60），随后在保留测试集上评估该固定策略的性能。实验表明，该方法将测试集平均成本从0.763降至0.472，相对减少38.1%，同时将错误路由率由15.3%降至3.5%。此外，研究还揭示了模型校准（calibration）与判别能力（discrimination）之间的可分离性，强调需同时报告正确性AUROC和风险覆盖率区域（tie-aware risk-coverage area）以全面评估性能。尽管生成式大语言模型（Generative AI）在某些提示配置下表现优于传统模型，但其在零样本/少样本场景下的泛化能力仍受限，且部分配置在断点概率0.80处会全部拒绝工单，凸显了成本敏感型拒答机制在实际部署中的重要性。本研究构建的是一个评估框架，而非通用的拒答算法或部署认证标准。

Abstract:Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.

[NLP-2] Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）中n-gram嵌入表（n-gram embedding tables）带来的巨大内存开销问题，这类表虽能显著提升语言模型性能，但其参数量庞大（如DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash中高达1960亿参数），制约了模型的可扩展性与部署效率。解决方案的关键在于采用低精度量化（low-bit quantization）策略，系统性地研究不同量化方法及比特分配方案，将n-gram嵌入表压缩至四比特（4-bit）时，可在保持超过99%原始验证损失下降效果的前提下，实现约75%的内存节省。进一步发现，通过短周期微调可部分恢复因低精度导致的性能损失，且将节省的内存重新投入构建更大规模的嵌入表，反而能在更低内存占用下超越原全精度表的性能表现。该方法在多个主流模型家族（NanoChat、Llama、GPT-2）及现有大模型（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）上均验证有效，实现47%-55%的内存节约，同时维持极小的困惑度上升（<1.2%）和下游任务性能基本不变。研究表明，低比特精度是降低n-gram嵌入内存需求并释放资源以增强模型性能的可行且高效路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31646
作者: Stephen Chung,Wenyu Du
机构: DualverseAI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 24 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.

[NLP-3] Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agent ic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2 EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言数据构建流水线（如FineWeb2）在跨千种语言应用统一处理策略时，未能识别和应对特定语言独特失败模式的问题。其核心挑战在于：现有方法依赖大语言模型（LLM）进行分类，但这种方式成本高昂且难以定位具体缺陷的成因与分布。本文提出一种创新解决方案——将大语言模型作为“语料库调试器”而非分类器使用，通过一个工具型智能体（tool-using agent）以只读、预算受限的API方式探索语料库，并将发现转化为可执行测试，由母语者验证。在对FineWeb2中2650万条斯洛伐克语文档的实验中，该方法以每次$2.21–$2.84的成本，在三次运行中识别出七项缺陷，涵盖四种现象，其中最大问题为一个包含1,408,437篇（占5.32%）机器生成内容的农场，其中86.6%甚至通过了更严格的过滤标准。盲测标签支持其中六项发现（缺陷率0.53–1.00，对比随机对照组0.08），一项未被支持。所生成的测试套件可在无需GPU的情况下仅用0.7秒扫描全量语料，远低于传统基于LLM分类的每轮$12k–$90k成本。尽管静态采样基线在验证更多选择器方面表现更优，且成本不足一半，但该智能体仍提供精确的缺陷出现频率、经采样文档验证的精度估计、流水线遗漏各子集的原因分析以及可复用的测试逻辑。研究团队已开源该框架、斯洛伐克语测试套件、验证数据及智能体轨迹。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31636
作者: Marek Šuppa,Ivan Vykopal,Jaroslav Kopčan
机构: Comenius University in Bratislava (布拉迪斯拉发考门纽斯大学); Cisco Systems(思科系统); Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies (KInIT) (肯佩伦智能技术研究所); Brno University of Technology (布尔诺理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to WaC Workshop at EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multilingual pipelines such as FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving the failure modes of individual languages unanticipated. We use an LLM once, as a corpus debugger rather than a classifier: a tool-using agent explores the corpus through a read-only, budgeted API and compiles each finding into an executable test, which a native speaker then validates. On the 26.5M-document Slovak portion of FineWeb2, three runs costing \ 2.21-\ 2.84 each found seven findings over four phenomena. The largest is a machine-generated content farm of 1,408,437 documents (5.32%) that passed the pipeline’s filters, 86.6% of it passing even stricter thresholds. Blinded labels support 6 of the 7 findings (defect rates .53-1.00 against .08 in a random control) and do not support one. The compiled suite scans the full corpus in 0.7 s of wall-clock time without a GPU, against \ 12k-\ 90k per LLM classification pass. The best static sampling baseline validates more selectors than any agent run, at under half the cost. The agent contributes exact prevalence, a precision estimate checked against sampled documents, an account of why the pipeline missed each slice, and a reusable test. We release the framework, Slovak test suite, validation data and agent trajectories.

[NLP-4] Bilingual Language Models Capture Cross-Linguistic Influence in Second-Language Reading

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有单语语言模型（LM）突现性（surprisal）在预测第二语言（L2）阅读时间时无法有效捕捉母语（L1）对非母语阅读行为影响的问题。其核心解决方案在于探究双语语言模型中的跨语言迁移是否与读者的L1驱动认知偏差相一致。研究通过分析来自12种不同L1背景的读者在阅读英语文本时的眼动数据，对比了与读者L1匹配的双语模型、单语英语基线模型及其他非匹配L1训练的双语模型的表现。结果表明，当双语模型的训练语言与读者的L1一致时，其对L2阅读时间的预测能力显著提升；这种优势主要体现在眼动后期指标中，且受L1-L2文字系统重叠程度调节，在中等语言水平读者中表现最为突出。该研究为双语语言模型能够捕获跨语言影响提供了实证支持，并揭示了L1对L2阅读行为的深层作用机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31620
作者: Abderrahmane Issam,Irene E. Winther,Stefan L. Frank
机构: Maastricht University (马斯特里赫特大学); Radboud University (奈梅亨大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While monolingual language model (LM) surprisal is widely established as a predictor of reading times, it cannot capture the non-native (L2) reading dynamics that are shaped by the reader’s first language (L1). In this work, we investigate whether the cross-lingual transfer within bilingual models aligns with human L1-driven biases during L2 reading. We evaluate bilingual models on eye-tracking data of readers from 12 diverse L1 backgrounds reading English texts. To isolate L1-specific transfer, we compare bilingual models trained on an L1 that matches the readers’ L1 background to both a monolingual English baseline and bilingual models trained on other L1s. We demonstrate that matching the readers’ L1 improves the prediction of L2 reading times. This predictive advantage is concentrated in late-stage eye-tracking measures, modulated by L1-L2 script overlap, and peaks among intermediate-proficiency readers. These findings provide evidence that bilingual LMs capture aspects of cross-linguistic influence, and that such influence is present in L2 reading behavior.

[NLP-5] How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决临床检索增强生成（RAG）系统在乳腺病灶管理文献检索中，检索评分对标注覆盖度依赖性过强的问题。其核心解决方案在于提出一种基于证据感知的检索评估协议，通过引入更精细的证据跨度（evidence span）标注机制与重叠分块策略，提升检索结果的相关性评估可靠性。关键创新点包括：采用混合检索方法（融合密集嵌入、BM25及交叉编码器重排序），结合384词元分块与20%重叠配置，在18个查询的开发基准上实现高召回率（Recall@3=0.94）、高R-Precision和nDCG@3等指标；同时，通过扩展标注范围（证据跨度由25增至37，可接受分块目标由36增至51），在不改变检索排名的前提下提升了系统对真实证据的识别能力，凸显了标注覆盖度对评估结果的影响，强调需进行独立验证（如放射科医生对证据充分性的评估）以确保评估的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31606
作者: Miguel Mochizuki Silva,Samuel Ismael,Mateus C. Dias,Thaís Gaudêncio,Yuri Malheiros,Barufaldi
机构: Universidade Federal da Paraíba (UFPB), João Pessoa, PB, Brazil; Department of Radiology, Perelman School of Medicine, University of Pennsylvania, Philadelphia, PA, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 18 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.

[NLP-6] Would an LLM Match into a Residency? Uncertainty Reasoning and Image Use of Open Language Models on the Spanish MIR Examination

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在医学影像诊断场景中应用时的可信度与可靠性问题，尤其关注开放模型在实际医疗系统部署中的关键挑战：模型是否具备自我识别错误的能力、医学微调能否提升其判断置信度的准确性、其正确答案是否基于合理的临床推理，以及模型是否真正利用了输入的影像数据。研究针对四个参数规模为8至270亿的开源语言模型，在西班牙医学影像住院医师考试（Spanish MIR residency examination）的8个版本共1,552道题目上进行评估，严格遵循考试评分规则。结果显示，尽管较大模型在排名上可进入前600至3,000名候选人范围，但其置信度无法有效区分正确与错误答案；医学微调虽降低了模型的过度自信，却以牺牲准确率为代价，且未改善置信度与答案正确性之间的分离能力。此外，13%至38%的正确回答因不具临床合理性的排除干扰项理由而得出，且移除或替换输入图像后模型性能保持不变，表明其决策过程并未真正依赖图像信息。因此，该研究的核心发现是：当前开源模型在医学诊断任务中仍缺乏可靠的自我评估能力，且其“正确”答案可能源于非临床逻辑或未使用关键输入信息，这严重制约了其在真实医疗环境中的可信部署。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31586
作者: Miguel Fernandez-de-Retana,Unai Zulaika,Ruben Sanchez-Corcuera,Aritz Bilbao-Jayo,Aitor Almeida
机构: University of Deusto (德乌斯托大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 13 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Accuracy on medical examinations is common evidence offered for the clinical use of language models, yet a health system that intends to run an open model on its own hardware needs to know considerably more: whether the model recognizes when it is likely to be wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves this ability, whether its correct answers rest on sound clinical reasoning, or whether it actually uses the images it is given. We examine these questions for four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters on the Spanish MIR residency examination, scoring 1,552 questions from eight editions under the exam’s own rules. Answering every question, the three larger models would rank among roughly the first 600 to 3,000 candidates, with 41 to 43 specialties still open to them. Abstention, however, never pays, because even their least confident answers are right more often than the 25% break-even. Medical fine-tuning reduced overconfidence at the cost of accuracy, without improving how well confidence separates right from wrong answers. Moreover, 13-38% of correct answers rejected a distractor for a clinically unsound reason that confidence did not reflect, and removing or swapping the provided contextual images left accuracy unchanged.

[NLP-7] Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有连续空间攻击方法中因依赖非学习的随机映射（random mapping）生成提示而导致提示不自然、易被输入防护机制检测，且风险评估结果缺乏真实语言分布支撑的问题。其解决方案的关键在于将原有的连续潜空间框架与一个经过学习的语言生成分布——连续扩散语言模型（dLLM, continuous diffusion language model）直接耦合，从而摒弃了人工构造的随机映射，同时保留标准高斯潜空间结构及下游采样或优化流程。实验表明，在基于采样的RareTrap和基于优化的ThinkTrap两种设置下，字符级困惑度分别从10³–10⁷降至3–5，以及从20–28降至4.3–5.4，显著提升了提示的自然性；同时，不同映射方式下的模型风险估计值可相差一个数量级，验证了所提方法在生成更可信、更隐蔽恶意提示方面的优势。

作者: Ali Al-Lawati,Elsayed Eshra,Dongwon Lee,Suhang Wang
机构: The Pennsylvania State University (宾夕法尼亚州立大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:\emphContinuous-space attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emphrandom mapping and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emphRareTrap and optimization-based search using \emphThinkTrap. We find that character-level perplexity drops from 10^3 – 10^7 to 3–5 in RareTrap and from 20–28 to 4.3–5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.

[NLP-8] An Empirical Study of Recent Large Language Models for Knowledge Graph to Text Generation on Standard Benchmarks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决知识图谱到文本（KG-to-text）生成任务中评估方法与模型性能之间的不一致性问题，尤其关注传统基于参考文本的评估指标与新型基于图结构的无参考评估方法之间的差异。其核心挑战在于：尽管近年来大语言模型（LLM）在生成质量上表现优异，但现有主流评估方式（如BLEU、ROUGE等参考基准指标）可能无法全面反映生成内容对知识图谱事实的忠实度与逻辑一致性。解决方案的关键在于引入一种图结构引导的无参考评估框架，利用大语言模型进行基于知识图谱事实的自动验证，从而更准确地衡量生成结果与输入图谱的一致性。实验表明，尽管基于参考的指标显示LLM与微调的编码器-解码器模型差距缩小，但图基评估揭示了提示型LLM在减少矛盾陈述和三元组遗漏方面显著优于微调模型，且后者在图规模增大时错误率上升更快，说明参考基准指标可能忽略生成质量中的关键缺陷。这一发现强调了采用图结构约束的评估方法对于真实性能判断的重要性。

作者: Priyanka,Renaud Delbru,Souhail Bakkali,Mickaël Coustaty,Antoine Doucet
机构: La Rochelle Université(拉罗谢尔大学); Siren(西伦); Université de Rennes(雷恩大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 18 pages, 6 figures, 17 tables, Preprint, Under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Knowledge graph-to-text (KG-to-text) generation verbalizes a set of knowledge graph triples into fluent natural language. While fine-tuned encoder-decoder models have long been the standard approach, recent LLMs are becoming increasingly competitive. We benchmark recent LLMs against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models, using reference-based metrics and graph-grounded reference-free LLM-based evaluation validated against human annotations. We observed that recent LLMs substantially narrow, and in several settings close, the gap with fine-tuned models on reference-based metrics, while performing better on graph-grounded metrics. LLM-based evaluation scores show limited correlation with reference-based metrics, suggesting that the two approaches capture different aspects of generation quality. Graph-grounded evaluation reveals that prompted models produce fewer contradictions and triple omissions than fine-tuned models, and these errors increase more rapidly with graph size for fine-tuned models, highlighting differences between the two approaches that reference-based metrics may not fully capture.

[NLP-9] he Geometry of Metaphor: Probing and Steering Metaphor Representations in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）中隐喻（metaphor）认知表征的可解释性及其可控性问题。隐喻作为人类认知的核心特征，其在模型中的内在表示机制尚不明确，且缺乏有效手段对其进行干预与调控。论文提出的关键解决方案是采用机械可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）技术，识别不同架构与规模的LLMs中与隐喻相关的关键因果子空间（causal subspaces）。研究发现，通过操纵这些子空间，可在分类任务中对不同词性的输出进行定向引导，并在生成任务中有效调节模型输出的隐喻程度，证明该方法具备对模型隐喻表达进行精准控制的能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31520
作者: Shihui Li,Mette Andersen,Martha Lewis
机构: Institute for Logic, Language, and Computation(逻辑、语言与计算研究所); University of Amsterdam(阿姆斯特丹大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: BlackboxNLP 2026: The 9th Workshop on Analyzing and Interpreting Neural Networks for NLP

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Metaphor is a crucial aspect of human cognition. As such, we would like to understand how it is represented in large language models (LLMs) and how it might be controlled. We use mechanistic interpretability techniques to identify causal subspaces in a range of LLMs covering different architectures and sizes. We show that we are able to steer output on classification tasks across different parts of speech. We are also able to steer output on generation tasks, indicating that these techniques can be used to control the metaphoricity of LLM output.

[NLP-10] owards User Simulators That Stay On Task And Still Sound Natural

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在长时间、多轮交互任务中性能退化的问题，核心挑战在于构建能够同时忠实遵循复杂用户意图并具备真实对话行为特征的用户模拟器。现有方法存在明显权衡：基于提示的助手虽能较好遵循复杂意图，但对话行为缺乏自然性；而专用用户模拟器虽更贴近真实对话模式，却难以长期保持对复杂意图的忠实度。本文提出一种强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）框架，通过联合奖励机制同时优化任务意图遵循度与对话自然性。其关键创新在于采用轻量级判别器，在交替对抗训练过程中对模拟器的自然性进行量化评估，从而实现对“自然性”的可操作化建模。基于此方法，研究团队发布了UserLM-2.0模型，能够在46.2%的情况下生成既符合任务要求又具备自然对话特征的模拟对话，显著优于前代最强模型（14.1%），提升超过三倍。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31512
作者: Mustafa Omer Gul,Philippe Laban,Tanya Goyal,Jennifer Neville
机构: Cornell University (康奈尔大学); Microsoft Research (微软研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 30 pages, 16 figures, 6 tables. In submission

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. We release the resulting model, UserLM-2.0, which produces valid simulated conversations (i.e., meeting both task-faithfulness and naturalness criteria) 46.2% of the time, over three times the rate of the strongest prior user simulator (14.1%).

[NLP-11] Measuring the Verifiers Floor: How Much Apparent Rare-Word Text-to-Speech Error Is ASR Error? ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决文本到语音（TTS）系统评估中存在的偏差问题，即传统评估方法依赖自动语音识别（ASR）系统对合成语音进行转写，导致词错误率（WER）不仅反映TTS系统的性能，还包含ASR系统的识别误差。研究发现，在人类录音中，现有ASR系统对极罕见词汇的漏识率高达33%-67%（在LibriSpeech和FLEURS数据集上），且三类识别器均存在22%-42%的漏识率。通过引入多个不同家族的ASR模型进行交叉验证，可将部分极罕见词汇的误判率显著降低（如非常罕见的LibriSpeech词汇从10%-13%降至3%-5%），但这些词汇仍是评估中最难处理的部分。然而，若忽略在人类语音中被识别器遗漏的词汇，则会产生系统性偏差——其他识别器在这些词汇上检测出的TTS错误频率远高于被遮蔽的词汇（4%-6% vs. 0.2%-0.3%），并纠正了约一半原被掩盖的错误。由于剩余经人工判定的错误中约有一半可能为拼写变体，因此论文强调必须辅以听觉测试以获得更准确的评估结果。其解决方案的关键在于：采用多模型、多族系的ASR交叉验证机制，并结合人工听觉测试，以减少评估过程中的识别器偏差，从而更真实地反映TTS系统的实际表现。

作者: Kirill Borodin,Vasilii Kudryavtsev,Nikita Vasiliev,Grach Mkrtchian
机构: 未知
类目: ound (cs.SD); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Text-to-speech (TTS) is usually evaluated by transcribing its output with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system, so the word error rate also counts recognizer errors. We measure these errors on human recordings of the test sentences. On LibriSpeech and FLEURS, the evaluation recognizer misses 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech, and all three recognizers miss 22-42%. Checking every word with two more recognizer families lowers the apparent TTS error on words that at least one recognizer hears two- to three-fold (very rare LibriSpeech words: from 10-13% to 3-5%), yet very rare words remain the hardest. Ignoring words the recognizer misses in human speech is biased: the other recognizers find TTS errors far more often on these words (4-6% vs. 0.2-0.3%) and overturn about half of the errors this mask keeps. As half of the remaining adjudicated errors may be spelling variants, a listening test is needed.

[NLP-12] From Structured Records to Patient Narratives: Preserving Clinical Alignment in LLM -Generated Health Summaries

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决可穿戴与数字健康系统生成的纵向生理数据在向患者传递时，如何实现临床信息向可读性语言有效转化的问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管生成式人工智能（Generative AI）能够将结构化临床数据转化为自然语言摘要，但在此过程中易产生语义漂移（semantic drift），导致临床意义失真。为此，论文提出一种基于提示的约束生成框架，通过结合结构化证据条件化与检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG），以实现证据驱动的健康摘要生成。该方案的关键在于引入显式的证据接地约束机制，在保证生成内容与原始医学证据一致性的基础上，显著提升临床语义对齐度，尤其在不确定性表达的保留方面表现突出；同时，在与检索到的证据进行忠实度验证后，整体上保持或提升了生成内容的忠实性，但遗漏问题仍依赖于具体模型表现。研究还发现，提升临床准确性的同时会带来阅读难度增加和医学术语使用增多的副作用。因此，该研究强调在开发面向患者的医疗生成式AI系统时，必须协同评估生成内容的忠实性、不确定性保留能力及可读性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31467
作者: Bayram Ayadi,Florian Geissler,Johanna Schmidhuber
机构: University of Passau (帕绍大学); Fraunhofer Institute for Cognitive Systems IKS (弗劳恩霍夫认知系统研究所IKS)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 18 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.

[NLP-13] Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale DATE

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在未见过的图结构中，利用语言模型从起点节点 $ s $ 到终点节点 $ t $ 生成最短路径的问题。现有研究发现，随着图规模增大，语言模型难以有效学习此任务。本文指出该失败现象源于两个独立因素：监督信号设计与节点标记化（tokenization）方式。其解决方案的关键在于：首先，理论分析并实证验证了多令牌预测（Multi-Token Prediction, MTP）的有效性，且其优势与图的拓扑结构无关；其次，提出替代性的节点标记化策略，证明上述两个因素具有正交性。通过结合MTP与优化的标记化方法，该研究突破了先前工作所观察到的性能“缩放墙”，实现了在远超以往极限的图规模下稳定、一致地学习最短路径生成任务。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31439
作者: Arvid Frydenlund,FuTe Wong,Katherine Lambert,Frank Rudzicz
机构: University of Toronto(多伦多大学); Vector Institute(向量研究所); Manulife Applied AI Research(加拿大宏利应用人工智能研究)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Don’t be intimidated by the page length :)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Given an unseen graph, a start node, s , and an end node, t , can a language model generate the shortest path from s to t ? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.

[NLP-14] How Well Do Decision Models Transfer to Vietnamese? An Empirical Study of Text Classification

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在越南语零样本文本分类任务中性能评估不足的问题，尤其关注专用决策模型在面对越南语语言特性时的适应性与鲁棒性。其核心解决方案的关键在于系统评估四类专用决策模型在13个分类任务中的表现，涵盖英语、越南语及双语标签描述，并考察其对越南语拼写变体（如去声调、错别字、网络用语）的敏感性。研究发现，标签描述的语言选择显著影响模型性能，且去声调处理导致的性能下降最为严重（平均宏观F₁值降低9.51–15.47分），远超其他扰动类型，凸显了在构建面向越南语的零样本分类系统时，需优先考虑标签描述语言策略与越南语正字法变异的建模。

作者: Phat Huu Ha,Nguyen Xuan Phuc,Nong Nhut Quy,Trinh Tran Tran,Nguyen Minh Triet,Dang Van Thin
机构: University of Information Technology, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam(胡志明市信息科技大学); Vietnam National University HoChiMinh City, Vietnam(越南国家胡志明市大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in specialized decision models have expanded the possibilities for zero-shot classification, yet their effectiveness on Vietnamese remains underexplored. This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 classification settings spanning six task groups, examining zero-shot performance, sensitivity to label-description language, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic variations. The evaluation considers English, Vietnamese, and bilingual label descriptions, alongside common linguistic perturbations involving teencode, typographical errors, and diacritic removal. Under English label descriptions, JEV achieves the strongest overall performance, ranking first in 11 classification settings. The effects of label-description language vary across models and datasets, with bilingual descriptions providing no consistent improvement. Robustness experiments reveal that diacritic removal causes the most substantial performance degradation, reducing mean macro- F_1 by 9.51–15.47 points across model configurations, considerably more than teencode or typographical errors. These findings highlight the importance of label-description choices and Vietnamese orthographic variation when evaluating specialized decision models for zero-shot text classification.

[NLP-15] How Depth Growth and Looping Shape In-Context Learning in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在上下文学习（In-Context Learning, ICL）中如何通过深度增长（depth-growth）与循环结构（looping）实现计算复用，进而影响其学习能力的形成机制问题。核心挑战在于理解这种参数复用机制如何塑造模型对上下文信息的依赖性、提升其在少样本场景下的推理能力，并揭示其内在的归纳偏置（inductive bias）。解决方案的关键在于：通过系统实验分析不同规模预训练模型（最高达30亿参数）在受控任务中的表现，发现采用深度增长或循环结构的模型相比全深度密集型基准模型，更早习得并更强保留上下文学习能力；进一步通过注意力头追踪与消融实验表明，这类模型显著依赖于“诱导性注意力头”（induction heads），且这些头部在训练过程中随深度增长被跨层传播，从而强化了对上下文信息的利用。研究结果表明，（软）参数复用不仅促进了模型对上下文的学习倾向，还重塑了支持该能力的注意力机制结构，揭示了一种共享的、以从上下文中学习为导向的归纳偏置。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31421
作者: Ferdinand Kapl,Kaitlin Maile,Stefan Bauer,Johannes von Oswald
机构: Technical University of Munich (慕尼黑工业大学); Helmholtz AI (海姆霍兹人工智能); Munich Center for Machine Learning (慕尼黑机器学习中心); Google(谷歌), Paradigms of Intelligence Team
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped and depth-grown language models reuse computations across depth and have attracted interest for their reasoning capabilities. Building on prior suggestive evidence of improved in-context-learning (ICL), we investigate how such reuse favors ICL, including how it shapes the acquisition, retention, and mechanisms of this ability. Our analysis spans pretrained language models up to 3B parameters and controlled tasks. The experiments provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context: grown and looped models rely more on information in context and, compared with a full-depth dense reference, acquire ICL earlier in controlled tasks and retain it more strongly when learning fixed associations in the weights is also possible. Tracing attention heads through training reveals that depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers. Ablations show that grown and looped models rely more strongly on induction-ranked heads for both few-shot performance and later-token prediction. Together, these findings provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context and suggest that (soft) parameter reuse shapes how this ability develops and which attention mechanisms support it.

[NLP-16] SyRA-CS: Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation for Code-Switched ASR with Meta-Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言语码转换（Code-switched, CS）自动语音识别（ASR）中真实语码转换语音数据稀缺、而合成语音与真实语音存在分布差异的问题。现有方法在利用合成数据进行模型预训练或持续微调时，难以有效迁移到真实场景。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于Reptile元学习的成对合成到真实适应框架SyRA-CS，通过在对应语言对的合成语码转换FLEURS子集上进行元训练，获得对适应任务更具鲁棒性的初始化参数，随后仅需1小时标注的真实目标语音即可完成高效适配。实验表明，该方法在阿拉伯语-英语、法语-英语、德语-英语和印地语-英语等多组语言对上，相较持续微调在词错误率（WER）上实现了17.7%（XLS-R模型）至5.3%-5.8%的相对宏平均降低，在字符错误率（CER）上也有显著提升，验证了合成数据在提供适应友好初始化方面的有效性，且性能增益在不同架构、语言对和评估指标间保持一致但大小各异。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31415
作者: Fadel Thior,Ahmer Tabassum,Haania Siddiqui,Hanan Aldarmaki,Thamar Solorio
机构: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificially Intelligence (穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Code-switched (CS) automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains difficult because real CS speech is scarce and synthetic speech does not fully match it. We investigate whether synthetic CS speech is more useful for learning an adaptation-friendly initialization than for ordinary continual fine-tuning. We propose SyRA-CS, a pair-specific synthetic-to-real adaptation framework based on Reptile meta-learning. For each language pair and pretrained model, we meta-train on the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset and then adapt using one hour of labeled real target speech. We evaluate four architectural settings: Encoder-CTC, FastConformer-RNN-T, Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) and Speech-LLM. Experiments cover on Arabic-, French-, German-, and Hindi-English, against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning. SyRA-CS improves over continual fine-tuning on WER in all 16 model-pair comparisons and on CER in 15 of 16, with relative macro WER reductions of 17.7% for XLS-R and 5.3-5.8% for the other three models. The gains hold across the tested models but vary in size across architectures, language pairs and metrics.

[NLP-17] SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）中大规模语言模型（LLMs）在低比特量化（low-bit quantization）下的性能损失问题，尤其聚焦于基于格点的向量量化（lattice-based Vector Quantization, VQ）在量化感知训练（VQ-QAT）中的行为不明确与可扩展性差的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持高压缩率的同时，维持模型在量化后的表达能力与训练稳定性。解决方案的关键是提出SQuAT（Shape-Gain Vector Quantization with Separate Straight-Through Estimators），通过将权重分解为方向（shape）和幅度（gain）两部分：方向分量采用基于E8E_8E8​格点的球面码本进行量化，而幅度分量则独立使用低比特标量量化器处理；同时，针对方向和幅度分别设计独立的直通估计器（STE），从而在反向传播中诱导切空间（tangent-space）更新，隐式地实现球面（Riemannian）优化，有效捕捉权重的几何结构特性。此外，为支持超大规模模型训练，论文还开发了一种分布式精确最近邻分配方案，仅需通信离散索引，显著降低通信开销，使训练时间缩短12.8倍，并成功将VQ-QAT扩展至100亿词元级别的训练规模。实验表明，SQuAT在多个指令微调的LLaMA-3.2及Qwen系列模型上均优于标准VQ-QAT，且在相同量化精度与初始化条件下达到当前最优（SOTA）的量化感知训练准确率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31412
作者: Sebastian Loeschcke,Ivan Koryakovskiy,Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa,Riccardo Del Chiaro,Mart van Baalen,Paul N. Whatmough,Markus Nagel
机构: University of Copenhagen (哥本哈根大学); Qualcomm AI Research (高通人工智能研究院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 7 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an E_8 -derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8 \times and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.

[NLP-18] Same Entity Different Script: Diagnosing Cross-Script Entity Matching Failures in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言大模型在处理同一人名以不同文字书写时产生的身份判断偏差问题，即模型对相同实体在不同脚本（如拉丁字母与天城文）下的身份匹配能力显著下降。其核心问题是：尽管输入语义一致，但模型在非拉丁脚本中的同一个人名识别准确率大幅降低，反映出明显的脚本依赖性偏差。解决方案的关键在于识别并干预模型内部导致该偏差的因果机制——研究发现，模型在中间层对第二实体的激活响应存在关键敏感性，且通过激活修补（activation patching）在此位置施加事实无关的干预，可将马拉雅拉姆语同名人名判断准确率从6.5%提升至33.5%，同时保持98.5%的异名人名判断准确率。此外，标量校准（scalar calibration）能恢复约87%的原始模型-探针平衡准确率差距，表明决策阈值的位置是造成偏差的重要因素。这些结果共同揭示了脚本依赖性歧视的本质并非源于表征差异，而是由决策准则的不当分布及特定神经路径的因果敏感性所致，从而为改进跨语言身份推理提供了可操作的干预靶点。

作者: Athira Gopal,Patil Prathamesh Pravin,Ankush Kadu,Arpit Jain,Ashwanth Krishnan
机构: QpiAI India(智普科技)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
