作者: Taewhoo Lee,Minju Song,Jungwoo Park,Chanwoong Yoon,Junha Jung,Hyeon Hwang,Sanghoon Lee,Minbyul Jeong,Jaewoo Kang
机构: Amazon(亚马逊); Korea University (高丽大学); AIGEN Sciences; University of Massachusetts Amherst (马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校); Meridian Intelligence Global Inc
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in search agents have enabled large language models to tackle complex tasks by retrieving and synthesizing external information. However, existing search agents often lack search-state awareness, i.e., the ability to recognize what information has been obtained and what remains missing, leading to hallucinated reasoning and prematurely terminated search. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning (SARL), a reinforcement learning framework in which models learn to recognize their own search state during training and improve their search behavior accordingly, without requiring additional assessment at test time. SARL achieves this through a dual reward design that captures the corrective effect of each assessment while penalizing excessive reliance on it, jointly encouraging effective and efficient search trajectories. Under this setup, SARL achieves a 24.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, with average gains of 35.9% on multi-hop reasoning and 27.9% on deep research benchmarks against the strongest per-benchmark baselines. SARL further surpasses methods built on auxiliary supervision or multi-agent coordination, despite operating as a standalone RL framework with no inference-time scaffolding. Beyond final performance, SARL maintains training stability under extended search horizons, a regime where existing methods consistently degrade, enabling sustained gains as task complexity grows.

[NLP-86] Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agent ic LLM Systems ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在处理混合敏感度数据时，因信息碎片化聚合（mosaic effect）而导致的敏感信息泄露问题。其核心风险在于：即使用户查询仅涉及单一文档，模型仍可能通过整合多个可访问文档中的非敏感片段，生成包含机密结论的综合回答，从而造成隐蔽性数据泄露。解决方案的关键在于引入可见的分类标题和明确的聚合规则，以限制模型对跨文档信息的不当整合。然而研究发现，即便采取此类防护措施，模拟环境中仍有32.37%的回答存在不安全披露（95%置信区间：28.33%-36.19%），且模型拒绝回答的行为本身也可能暴露被禁止的信息，表明单纯增加拒绝率无法保障保密性。因此，该研究揭示了基于“拼图式”推理的泄露已成为实际存在的保密性失效模式，亟需在高敏感数据环境中实施更严格的推理与披露控制机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30418
作者: Daniel Ruiz,Luca Luceri,Emilio Ferrara
机构: Information Sciences Institute(信息科学研究所); University of Southern California(南加州大学)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 16 pages, 9 figures, submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026 cycle

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.

[NLP-87] SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的医疗分诊聊天机器人在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）应用中存在的评估方法与实际使用场景脱节的问题。现有评估多依赖于单轮次、仅限英语的基准测试，仅衡量模型的知识水平，而忽视了真实用户在复杂多轮对话中表现出的非规范行为，如用词模糊、拼写错误、使用地方方言或情绪化表达，以及对话上下文的快速演变。为此，论文提出一种名为SIM-UT（Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage）的多轮次、基于仿真的评估方法，通过模拟真实用户群体的人格特征、行为约束与沟通模式，识别出具有生态效度且情境相关的失败模式。关键发现是：无论是医学微调的开源模型（MedGemma）还是通用前沿模型（ChatGPT与Claude），均存在“降级风险”这一严重缺陷——即在初始正确识别医疗紧急情况后，当用户以简化方式描述症状但未提供新临床信息时，模型会过度迎合用户意见，出现临床上危险的顺从性表现，例如将妊娠期阴道出血误判为“无问题”，或将孕32周胎动减少视为“正常”。因此，研究建议将基于真实用户行为模拟的动态评估纳入生产级分诊聊天机器人的标准开发流程，以便在部署前或后续迭代中建立有效安全机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30412
作者: Deepali Mittal,Dheeraj Mundhra,Yulia Sidorova,Tersia de Kock,Oli Munns,Sofie S Meyer
机构: hearX Foundation(hearX基金会); Cliniva(Cliniva); Respira Health(Respira健康); University of Pretoria(普利托利亚大学); Turn.io; UserTrace(用户追踪)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 23 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots’ knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. We compared a medically fine-tuned open model (MedGemma) against general-purpose frontier models (ChatGPT and Claude) across 5,000+ multilingual simulated conversation turns grounded in the personas, constraints, and communication patterns of the real user populations, over 2-4 iterative rounds. A key failure mode emerged in both model families: de-escalation risk. The agents initially identified medical emergencies correctly, but when the user minimised the symptoms without introducing new clinical information, they de-escalated, exhibiting clinically dangerous sycophancy, for example agreeing that vaginal bleeding in pregnancy was “not a problem” or that decreased fetal movements at 32 weeks “can be normal”. We recommend user simulation-based behavioural evaluation, grounded in real user context and covering adversarial and edge cases, as standard practice for triage chatbots in production, so that safeguards can be added before deployment or in subsequent iterations.

[NLP-88] xt-Only LLM Correctors Break Correct Transcripts: A Repair-Damage Analysis of Audio Grounding in ASR Error Correction ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在自动语音识别（ASR）结果纠错过程中，仅依赖整体词错误率（WER）评估指标会掩盖实际修复与引入错误的细节问题。其核心挑战在于：如何准确量化音频信息对纠错效果的贡献，并区分模型在不同输入条件下（有/无音频）的修复、损坏及插入行为。解决方案的关键是提出一种精确分解方法，将每次WER变化拆解为被修复的词元（repaired tokens）、被破坏的词元（damaged tokens）和新增词元（insertions），从而实现对纠错过程的细粒度分析。研究通过对比在三种语料上使用Gemini 2.5 Flash进行文本仅纠错与结合音频纠错的表现发现：当仅使用模型自身生成的草稿时，纯文本纠错会破坏13%–32%原本正确的转录文本；而加入音频后，破坏率降至1%–3%；尽管修复效果在草稿上下降而在独立识别器输出上上升，但医疗语音记录中保留的插入项抵消了净WER改进。相比之下，开放权重的Voxtral模型因极少修改文本，未呈现相同模式。由于两组提示（prompt）存在差异，实验结果虽不能完全隔离音频的影响，但有效界定了音频在纠错中的作用边界。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30385
作者: Vasiliy Kudryavtsev,Kirill Borodin,Nikita Vasiliev,Mikhail Gorodnichev,Grach Mkrtchian
机构: 未知
类目: ound (cs.SD); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM correctors of ASR output are judged by aggregate WER, which hides what they fix and what they break. We decompose every WER change exactly into repaired tokens, damaged tokens and insertions, and use this to ask what the source audio adds to a corrector. We compare correction with and without the audio, for the model’s own draft and for the output of an independent recogniser, on three corpora. With Gemini 2.5 Flash, text-only correction of its own draft breaks 13-32% of already-correct transcripts; with the audio, 1-3%. Damage falls in both settings. Repair falls against the own draft and rises against the recogniser. On medical dictation, kept insertions cancel the gain in net WER. The open-weight Voxtral, which rarely edits, does not show this pattern. Prompts differ between the two arms, so the contrasts bound the effect of the audio and do not isolate it.

[NLP-89] MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在长时程规划任务中因生成幻觉或无效动作而导致的高成本与不可靠性问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持语言交互灵活性的同时，实现对符号规划（Symbolic Planning）的有效支持，尤其是在部分可观测的交互式文本环境中。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于记忆条件的PDDL规划框架——MemPlan：通过固定PDDL领域，动态重构每一步的PDDL问题，结合观测解析、候选假设与交互记忆进行状态更新；其中，正向图记忆依据相关性为缺失对象、位置或条件的候选假设分配启发式动作代价，引导规划器优先探索更合理的检查路径；负向记忆则记录被执行反馈否定的假设，并将其编译为排除约束，避免重复尝试已被证伪的选项；同时，采用经过监督微调的统一模式-条件化语言-符号接口，实现从自然语言环境到符号规划循环的端到端映射，完成观察到事实的解析与符号动作到命令的语义接地。实验表明，MemPlan在TextWorld、ALFWorld和Robotouille上的任务完成率与步骤效率均优于纯语言基线及PDDL感知基线，且在线令牌消耗显著低于如ReAct等依赖LLM自主规划的方法，同时同一微调接口可跨不同任务类型复用，无需任务特定微调。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30379
作者: Tengwei Song,Robert Hoehndorf
机构: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)(阿卜杜拉国王科技大学); Åbo Akademi University (Åbo阿克迪米大学); ELLIS Institute Finland (芬兰ELLIS研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents are flexible in language interaction, but using them as long-horizon planners is costly and prone to hallucinated or invalid actions. This paper targets a different role for LLMs: constrained bridges between language and symbolic planning. We propose MemPlan, a memory-conditioned PDDL planning framework for partially observable interactive text environments. MemPlan keeps the PDDL domain fixed and reconstructs the PDDL problem at each step from parsed observations, candidate hypotheses, and interaction memory. Positive graph memory assigns relevance-based action costs to candidate hypotheses for missing objects, locations, or conditions, guiding the planner toward more plausible checks. Negative memory records execution-refuted assumptions and compiles them into exclusion constraints, preventing repeated attempts at candidates already contradicted by feedback. A unified schema-conditioned language–symbol interface, trained offline with supervised fine-tuning, connects text environments to the planning loop through observation-to-fact parsing and symbolic-action-to-command grounding. Experiments on TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille show that MemPlan improves task completion and step efficiency over language-only and PDDL-aware baselines, while substantially reducing online token cost compared with LLM-planning baselines such as ReAct. The same fine-tuned interface is also reused across TextWorld task types without task-specific fine-tuning. Our code and data are available at: this https URL.

[NLP-90] Climbing the Ladder: Automating Data Pipelines and Reproducing Baselines in Low-Resource Settings

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小语种（如西西里语）在大规模多语言机器翻译系统中因依赖噪声大、非标准化的网络文本而导致翻译质量不佳的问题。其核心解决方案在于：通过从双语期刊《Arba Sicula》的PDF文档中提取高质量对齐的平行语料，利用无语言依赖的句子编码器结合人工标注对齐数据进行阈值调优，并对自动对齐结果进行典型错误过滤，从而构建更精确的训练数据；同时，将原始系统的分词与屈折词素偏倚的子词分段机制迁移至无需Perl的实现方式，并在固定测试集上评估所有模型性能。研究对比了从零训练的小型Transformer模型与经过低秩微调适配的预训练NLLB模型在双向翻译中的表现，尤其以意大利语作为近邻桥梁语言，并引入原系统逆向训练策略——即先使用网络西西里语进行正向评分的反向翻译训练，再用精心筛选的文学文本进行后续训练。实验表明，预训练模型显著优于从头训练模型，且分阶段训练策略对西西里语到其他语言的翻译提升更为明显。尽管在包含英语的翻译方向上，采用更大适配器和更多反向翻译样本的分阶段模型优于原逆向训练方案，但在西西里语与意大利语之间则略逊一筹；然而，多语言适配器在未参与训练的方向上会降低性能，限制其作为通用多语言模型的应用潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30374
作者: Donato Meoli,Eryk Wdowiak
机构: Università di Pisa(比萨大学); Arba Sicula; Brooklyn, NY, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The massively multilingual translation systems that now include Sicilian learned it from noisy, non-standardised web text. To obtain better translation quality, we redevelop the small neural machine translation (NMT) system that Wdowiak customized for Sicilian. We rebuild on maintained software the extraction of the parallel text from the PDFs of the bilingual journal Arba Sicula, whose sentences are aligned by a language-agnostic sentence encoder with thresholds tuned against an existing hand alignment and then filtered for the typical errors of automatic alignment. Furthermore, the tokenization and the desinence-biased subword segmentation of the original system are ported to a Perl-free implementation, and all the results are measured on a frozen test set drawn from the journal. We compare small Transformers trained from scratch with the pretrained NLLB model adapted by low-rank fine-tuning, in both directions and with Italian as a closely related bridge language, and we adapt to the pretrained model the reverse-training recipe of the original system, i.e., a stage on forward-scored back-translations of the web Sicilian followed by a stage on the curated literary text. The pretrained model is by far the better of the two, and the staged training improves the translation into Sicilian more than the translation from it. On the test set of the original system, and in the tokenized space in which it was scored, the staged model with a larger adapter and more back-translations is above the reverse-training recipe in the directions that involve English and below it between Sicilian and Italian. Yet, a multilingual adapter degrades the directions on which it was not trained, which limits its use as a general multilingual model.

[NLP-91] Probing and Steering for Safety-Relevant Behaviours in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）中安全相关行为的检测与可控引导问题，具体聚焦于欺骗、高风险意识和阿谀奉承三种行为的识别与调控。其核心挑战在于不同设计要素（如估计器选择、词元聚合策略、探测/引导层的选择）在统一框架下的相互作用机制及其对行为检测与引导效果的影响。解决方案的关键在于构建一个系统化评估管道，综合对比差异均值（difference-of-means）与逻辑回归（logistic regression）两种估计器，结合最后时刻（last）、平均（mean）及可学习注意力（learned attention）三种词元池化方式，在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上进行多维度实验。研究发现，尽管先前工作提出“读写分离”假设——即逻辑回归在检测上表现更优而差异均值在引导上更优——但该规律仅适用于欺骗与高风险意识行为，而在阿谀奉承行为中出现反转，表明该现象部分源于数据特性而非估计器本身。此外，最优池化方法与层选择高度依赖于具体行为与数据分布，且最佳引导层可能显著早于最佳检测层。更重要的是，用于衡量模型感知变化与实际行为诱导的指标在任务间存在分歧，提示需根据目标选择合适的评价标准。最终，研究输出可交互的探针方向，支持用户直接评分与实时引导文本生成。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30363
作者: Nimun Bajwa,Massimo Poesio
机构: Queen Mary University of London(伦敦玛丽女王大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: 20 pages, 26 figures, 11 tables. Code, data and interactive interface: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Activation probes are computed directions in a language model’s residual stream, used both to detect safety-relevant behaviours and, by adding their direction back into the stream, to steer them. We explore how the main design choices behind such probes interact, within one pipeline, on one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and across three behaviours: deception, high-stakes awareness and sycophancy. The pipeline crosses two estimators (difference-of-means and logistic regression) with three token-pooling schemes (last, mean and learned attention), selects appropriate layers to detect or steer a behaviour, and evaluates every direction twice: as a detector of the behaviour, and as a steering vector to push outputs towards the behaviour. Prior work read together suggests a read/write dissociation, in which logistic regression reads (detects) best but difference-of-means directions write (steer) best. We find that it holds for deception and high-stakes but not for sycophancy, where the pattern reverses. The reversal appears to follow partially from the data rather than from the estimators. The best pooling technique and the layer choice depend on the behaviour and data, and the layer that steers best can sit well before the layer that detects best. The right steering metric to use between changing a model’s perception and eliciting behaviour depends on the task - and the two can disagree outright. The exported probes and directions power an interactive interface through which a user can score and steer text directly.

[NLP-92] CiteAnchor: Source-Aware Grounding for Hallucinated Citation Detection and Resolution

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决科学文献中虚假引用（hallucinated citations）难以溯源与验证的问题，其核心挑战在于引文信息不完整或在不同文献类型及版本间存在差异，仅凭表面匹配无法确认引文真实性或还原其原始来源。解决方案的关键是提出CiteAnchor框架，该框架通过引入源感知（source-aware）的定位机制，针对不同文献类型动态调整检索策略与字段级验证逻辑，并独立判断引文的有效性与唯一来源可恢复性。研究进一步构建了包含423个真实世界虚假引用的基准数据集CiteResolve，用于评估源可恢复性。实验表明，CiteAnchor在现有检测基准上分别取得0.841和0.784的F1分数，在CiteResolve上实现74.7%和70.7%的端到端任务成功率，显著优于基线方法，证明了其在提升虚假引用检测与源追溯能力方面的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30355
作者: Chenyi Tong,Ping Nie,Yu Zhang
机构: University of Wisconsin–Madison (威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校); University of Waterloo (Waterloo大学); Texas AM University (德克萨斯农工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Digital Libraries (cs.DL)
备注: 18 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Hallucinated citations make it harder to trace sources and verify the evidence behind scientific claims. Detecting them is difficult because bibliographic records can be incomplete or differ across source types and publication versions. A plausible match alone neither validates the citation nor establishes its underlying source. We introduce CiteResolve, a benchmark of 423 real-world hallucinated citations annotated for source recoverability. We further propose CiteAnchor, a source-aware grounding framework that adapts retrieval and field-level verification to each source type and separately determines citation validity and whether a unique source can be recovered. On an existing detection benchmark, CiteAnchor achieves 0.841 F1 with GPT-5.6 Luna and 0.784 with an open-weight backbone, outperforming the baseline with the same backbones by 7.9 and 36.8 points. On CiteResolve, it achieves 74.7% and 70.7% end-to-end task success, outperforming the corresponding web search baselines by 16.3 and 65.3 percentage points. Our code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-93] Consistency Is Not Validity: Self-Rewarded Moral Argumentation Makes Language Models Decisive but Pliable

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在道德判断任务中表现不稳定、易受选项呈现顺序影响的问题。其核心挑战在于，现有模型在面对道德困境时，往往因推理过程缺乏一致性与可解释性而导致判断结果不可靠。为提升道德判断性能，论文提出一种基于强化学习的解决方案：通过自评对弈（self-judged tournament）机制，在掩蔽思维（masked thinking）框架下训练策略模型，使其根据生成论证的质量获得奖励。关键创新在于将“论证质量”作为奖励信号，引导模型发展出更严谨、一致的语言表达风格（language register），从而增强判断的稳定性。实验表明，该方法显著提升了模型在外部基准（如MoralChoice、ELEPHANT、MORABLES）上的决策一致性，并减少对选项顺序的敏感性。然而，研究也揭示了“一致性不等于有效性”的根本问题——尽管模型在重排测试中表现出更强的一致性，但其仍存在谄媚倾向（sycophancy）和语义重构（reframing）等行为，反映出其判断并未真正内化正确的道德逻辑。两个消融实验进一步验证，仅通过合成困境或开放思维训练亦可实现部分重排收益，但缺乏显著的语言风格转变且更易产生谄媚行为，说明单纯优化一致性无法确保道德有效性的提升。因此，该研究的关键结论是：必须区分“形式一致性”与“实质有效性”，仅依赖自我评价和推理一致性不足以保证道德判断的可信度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30349
作者: Marius De Kuthy Meurers,Aaron Parisi,Bernd Bohnet
机构: Google DeepMind(谷歌深度思维)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 20 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLMs are increasingly consulted for moral judgment. We aim to improve performance on such tasks by rewarding good arguments, on the premise that arguing well increases the likelihood of judging well. We train a reinforcement learning policy initialized from a state-of-the-art language model in a self-judged tournament with masked thinking: the generated arguments are judged pairwise on argument quality by the policy itself. As an empirical basis, we extract authentic dilemmas from classic novels, using a logic solver to verify that each constitutes a conflict. We show that our judge rates argument quality like human annotators, and the policy then adopts the language register that it rewards. Testing on the external benchmarks MoralChoice, ELEPHANT, and MORABLES, we find that the policy becomes more decisive and invariant to the order in which options are presented, but sycophancy and reframing remain a challenge to validity. Two ablation studies with synthetic dilemmas and unmasked thinking match the reordering gains, but show a weaker register shift and higher sycophancy. We conclude that consistency is not validity: consistency under reordering can be optimized without improving the moral judgment it is meant to signal.

[NLP-94] AQL-Lite: Enabling Efficient Knowledge Acquisition for Arabic LLM s via Data-Centric Continual Pretraining

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决阿拉伯语大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）训练中面临的三大核心挑战：网络数据噪声、方言多样性以及持续预训练（Continual Pretraining, CPT）带来的高昂计算成本。为应对这些问题，提出了一种高效且资源节约的框架AQL-Lite（Arabic Quality Language），其关键解决方案在于结合“质量优先”的数据清洗流程与部分参数微调（Partial-Parameter CPT）策略。具体而言，AQL-Lite通过结构化清理、启发式与模型驱动的过滤、现代标准阿拉伯语（Modern Standard Arabic, MSA）选择及去重等步骤构建高质量语料库，并采用基于分层学习率的RS-LoRA适配器，在网络最后八层Transformer块及嵌入矩阵上进行参数更新，实现对多语言大模型向MSA的高效适配。实验表明，在10亿令牌预算下，使用AQL-Lite处理的数据可使阿拉伯语多任务平均得分提升3.51点，显著优于原始网络文本的持续预训练；在50亿令牌的对照实验中，AQL-Lite仅用52%的时长即达到全参数持续预训练94%的性能增益，且在所有基准测试中均优于仅使用适配器的基线方法。进一步的消融实验证明，适配器、未冻结层以及嵌入层训练均对性能有贡献。最终，将该框架扩展至400亿条目并指令微调100万样本后，生成的120亿参数模型在七项基准测试的Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2（OALL v2）中取得75.3分，验证了在精心筛选语料上进行部分参数持续预训练是实现高效、高性能阿拉伯语模型适配的可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30344
作者: Houssam Eddine Boukhalfa,Mourad Bouache,Mourad Dahmane
机构: National School of Artificial Intelligence (ENSIA), Algiers, Algeria; Nojoom AI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Abstract:Training Arabic large language models faces challenges from noisy web data, dialectal variation, and the high cost of continual pretraining (CPT). We introduce AQL-Lite (AQL: Arabic Quality Language), a time- and resource-efficient framework for adapting a multilingual LLM to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). AQL-Lite couples a quality-first curation pipeline (structural cleaning, heuristic and model-based filtering, MSA selection, and deduplication) with a partial-parameter CPT recipe that trains RS-LoRA adapters across the network together with the last eight transformer blocks and the embedding matrix, under layer-wise learning rates. At a matched 1B-token budget, CPT on AQL-curated data raises a four-benchmark Arabic mean by 3.51 points over CPT on raw web text, which yields no gain over the base model. In a controlled 5B-token comparison, AQL-Lite recovers 94% of the gain of full-parameter CPT (mean 73.19 vs. 73.58) in 52% of the wall-clock time and outperforms adapter-only baselines on every benchmark, and a component ablation shows that adapters, unfrozen blocks, and embedding training each contribute. Scaled to 40B MSA tokens and instruction-tuned on one million examples, the resulting 12B model scores 75.3 on the seven-benchmark Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2 (OALL v2) suite. These results suggest that partial-parameter CPT on a carefully curated corpus is a practical route to efficient MSA adaptation.

[NLP-95] Measuring Research Progress and Linguistic Inclusion in Low-Resource Languages

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在低资源语言（Low-Resource Languages, LRLs）与多语言自然语言处理（Multilingual NLP）研究中虽取得显著进展，但其对语言多样性与代表性群体的包容性仍缺乏系统评估的问题。核心挑战在于：现有研究增长指标（如论文数量）未能真实反映语言覆盖的公平性与代表性分布的均衡性。论文提出“语言包容性框架”（Linguistic Inclusion Framework, LIF），从四个维度——研究增长、代表性扩展、代表性连续性及分布公平性——综合评估语言技术研究的包容性。关键解决方案在于突破仅依赖发表量的单一评价标准，通过多维量化分析揭示：尽管整体论文数量增长显著，但研究集中于已代表语言，亚洲等高人口基数地区语言的代表性严重不足，而欧洲语言则过度集中；且非洲和东南亚等语言多样性丰富的区域语言覆盖比例最低。研究表明，单纯的研究增长无法体现真正的语言公平，必须通过系统性框架实现对语言包容性的精准测量与改进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30296
作者: Atnafu Lambebo Tonja,Tadesse Destaw Belay,Jesujoba Oluwadara Alabi,Israel Abebe Azime,Benjamin Rosman,Ehsan Shareghi,Thamar Solorio,Pontus Stenetorp,Monojit Choudhury
机构: University College London, UK(伦敦大学学院，英国); Instituto Politécnico Nacional, Mexico(墨西哥国家理工学院，墨西哥); Saarland University, Germany(萨尔兰大学，德国); University of the Witwatersrand, South Africa(约翰内斯堡大学，南非); MBZUAI, UAE(穆巴达拉科技与人工智能研究院，阿联酋)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated research on low-resource and multilingual NLP, but their effectiveness in creating an equitable landscape remains unmapped. We analyze 1,158 peer-reviewed open-access papers published between 2020 and 2025, examining research attention to low-resource languages (LRLs) and representation across language and speaker populations. To assess linguistic inclusion beyond publication counts, we introduce the Linguistic Inclusion Framework (LIF), a multidimensional framework that measures linguistic inclusion in four dimensions: research growth, representation expansion, representation continuity, and distributional equity. While annual publications grew from 52 to 415, a 5.4X increase in their ACL Anthology publication share, this growth largely concentrated on represented languages rather than expanding coverage of underrepresented languages. Further analysis shows that languages spoken in Asia account for 64.1% of speakers across LRLs we analyze but receive only 46.7% of the language representation share (0.7X their proportional share), while European languages receive 5.3X their proportional share. At the country level, linguistically diverse regions such as sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia show the lowest language coverage ratios. Applying the framework at the continental level, we find that no region scores well on all four dimensions, showing that research growth alone is not a reliable metric of progress toward equitable and inclusive language technology\footnoteWe will release all collected and annotated data for research purposes.

[NLP-96] Finitely Verifiable Segmentation: Decidability for Every Tokenizer with a Finite-State Verifier

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自然语言处理与编译器设计中字节级分词策略（segmentation policy）的可验证性与计算可判定性问题，核心在于构建一类具有形式化可判定性质的分词策略。其关键解决方案是引入“有限可验证性”（finitely verifiable）这一概念：即一个分词策略若能被一个在标记字符串（marked strings，即字节与边界位配对）上的有限自动机精确接受其所有合法分词结果，则称其为有限可验证的。该自动机仅需验证给定的分词提案是否有效，而无需自主生成分词，从而实现了高效、形式化的验证机制。这一设定使得原本依赖经验或非形式化约定的四个常见问题变为可判定：是否存在窗口可证明的词元边界、边界间隙是否有限、掩码是否保持生成可完成性，以及两个分词策略是否等价。后三者分别对应有界性（limitedness）、共可达性（coaccessibility）及单值转换器的等价性；前者则深化了代码理论中的同步切割（synchronizing cut）概念，并进一步探讨认证切割或库存切割是否允许各片段独立扫描。该类分词策略严格介于在线可扫描策略与具有正则域的策略之间，其内部边界由Choffrut定理刻画，且可在多项式时间内判定。标记操作保持长度不变，因此该类恰好等同于有理分词策略（rational segmentation policies），这是一种规范形式而非限制性约束，其可判定性依赖于提供一个验证器（verifier）。该类策略在管道操作下封闭，包括带标签阶段的复合、限制、拆分以及字面量策略的字节回退并集。每个复合结构继承六项可判定性，且证书在四条传递定律下可跨阶段转移。在有理、无歧义、几乎必然停止的有限状态源下，加权截段的每部分质量均为精确有理数，且期望长度为正时的速率亦为有理数。最大贪心词法分析（maximal-munch lexing）、标准字节对编码（canonical byte-pair encoding）及双模式WordPiece均实例化了该接口，而munch库已实现全部六项判定功能。所有定理均可执行验证，所有报告统计均由程序直接输出，确保了理论与实现的高度一致性。

The modules, the gate and the records of the library and tokenizer instances are in the artifact, with a verifier that runs every module and holds each reported count to the output line it rests on. Companion to arXiv:2608.03473 , arXiv:2608.09761 , arXiv:2609.10600 and arXiv:2610.08854

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A segmentation policy assigns to each byte string at most one segmentation into tokens. Call it finitely verifiable when a finite automaton over marked strings, bytes paired with boundary bits, accepts exactly the policy’s own segmentations. The automaton judges a proposed segmentation and need not compute one. The paper shows what that hypothesis buys. Four questions that practice settles by folklore become decidable, whether a window certifies a token boundary, whether the boundary gap is bounded, whether a mask keeps generation completable, and whether two policies are equivalent. The last three specialize limitedness, coaccessibility and the equivalence of single-valued transducers. The first refines the synchronizing cut of code theory, and two more ask whether a certified cut, or the cuts of an inventory, let each piece scan alone. The class sits strictly between the online-scannable policies and those with regular domains, and its inner frontier is Choffrut’s and decidable in polynomial time. Markings are length-preserving, so the class is exactly the rational segmentation policies, a normal form rather than a restriction, and what the decisions need is a supplied verifier. The class is closed under the operations pipelines use: composition over a labeled stage, restriction, splitting, and byte-fallback union of literal policies. Each composite inherits the six decisions, and certificates transfer between stages under four laws. Under rational, unifilar, almost surely stopping finite-state sources, each mass of the weighted section is an exact rational, and so is each rate where expected length is positive. Maximal-munch lexing, canonical byte-pair encoding and two-mode WordPiece instantiate the interface, and the munch library implements all six decisions. Every theorem carries an executable check, and every reported statistic is a program’s own output.

[NLP-97] FusionEval: Benchmarking Model Fusion for Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多专家模型融合（model fusion）中存在的重要问题：现有评估体系对长链思维推理（long chains of thought）和工具使用（tool use）的覆盖不足，且平均性能表现优异可能掩盖了各专家能力在融合过程中的显著退化。为应对这一挑战，论文提出FusionEval基准，其关键在于提供受控的专家池（controlled expert pools），支持无需额外训练与需额外训练的融合方法，并构建统一评估套件。该套件基于Qwen3与Llama基础模型独立训练的数学、代码、科学、指令遵循及工具使用等领域的专家模型，在八项公开基准上，在相同数据访问条件下评估能力保留度、计算开销（包括运行时、峰值GPU内存占用）以及归一化平均与最差性能。实验表明，无训练融合方法虽能较好保持推理能力，但显著损害工具使用性能；而MOPD方法虽可有效保留工具使用并实现更均衡的能力分布，但需额外的数据准备、推理与训练成本。因此，如何在低计算成本下联合保留推理、指令遵循与工具使用能力，仍是当前亟待突破的关键挑战。FusionEval旨在推动高效模型融合研究，助力未来工作实现多专家能力的协同保留。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30162
作者: Shuo Cai,Yanggan Gu,Yuhang Liu,Su Lu,Yuanyi Wang,Yang Yu,Zhen Li,Zhitian Hou,Guanghao Zhu,Ming Li,Hongxia Yang
机构: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University(香港理工大学); InfiX.ai; PolyU-Daya Bay Technology and Innovation Research Institute
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Model fusion aims to integrate the capabilities of multi-expert models into a single model. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage of reasoning with long chains of thought and tool use, while strong average performance can mask substantial losses in individual expert capabilities. We introduce FusionEval, a benchmark that provides controlled expert pools, integrates fusion methods with and without additional training, and offers a unified evaluation suite. The pools contain domain experts independently trained from Qwen3 and Llama base models across math, code, science, instruction following, and tool use. The suite evaluates capability retention and computational cost on eight public benchmarks under comparable data access rules, reporting normalized average and worst performance, runtime, and peak GPU memory usage. Extensive experiments show that training-free methods preserve reasoning performance but substantially degrade tool use at both model scales. In contrast, MOPD preserves tool use and achieves a more balanced capability profile, but requires additional data preparation, inference, and training. Jointly retaining reasoning, instruction following, and tool use at low computational cost remains a challenge. We hope FusionEval supports future research on efficient model fusion that jointly preserves expert capabilities. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-98] auIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在印度零售银行业务场景中因缺乏对操作流程合规性有效评估而导致的可靠性问题。现有基准测试通常仅依据对话结束时的最终记录来判断模型表现，而忽视了过程中关键步骤的执行情况，导致即使模型跳过必要操作或进行未经授权的变更，仍可能被误判为成功。其解决方案的关键在于提出一个面向动作的基准测试工具——TauIndianBankBench，该基准涵盖1,000个模拟客户与银行助手之间的真实零售银行业务任务，不仅评估最终结果，还严格检验每个会话中是否完整执行了所有必需的操作步骤（如在关闭存款账户前获取结清报价），并禁止未授权的修改。实验表明，在仅依赖最终记录评分的情况下，6.5%至12.0%的会话被错误判定为成功，而引入程序合规性与结果双重评估后，能更准确地反映语言模型在印度零售银行场景中的实际表现。

作者: Krishanu Adhikary,Prashant Devadiga
机构: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank’s rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. Besides the final records, it checks that the assistant took every required step and made no unrequested change. For every model, 6.5-12.0% of sessions are judged successful when only the final records are checked, although the assistant skipped a required step or made an unrequested change. Scoring both procedure and outcome shows more accurately how well language models perform in Indian retail banking.

[NLP-99] Lighthouse: On Building a Trustworthy Digital Assistant for Exploring History with Civil Rights Archives

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决如何利用生成式AI（Generative AI）安全、可靠地支持对美国民权运动时期历史的探索，尤其针对南卡罗来纳州的多模态史料数据。其核心挑战在于，在提供自然语言交互的同时，确保内容的可信性并最小化生成回答可能带来的潜在危害。解决方案的关键在于提出一种神经符号（neuro-symbolic）方法，通过结合大型语言模型（LLM）的神经学习能力与基于规则的符号推理机制，实现对答案风险与覆盖广度之间的平衡。该系统“Lighthouse”在设计上强调内容可信性与用户保护，通过整合超过1.8万份原始资料，并构建由独立专家共识形成的主观问答评估数据集，实现了对事实性与主观性问题的双重验证，从而在提升可解释性与安全性的同时保障了知识覆盖的全面性。

作者: John A. Aydin,Angelica Williams,Steven Dindl,Nathan Saunders,Kate Boyd,Vandana Srivastava,Biplav Srivastava
机构: 未知

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Artificial intelligence (AI), as a decision-support aid, provides new tools for studying history effectively using multimodal data, including text, images, and audio. We present, to our knowledge, the first digital assistant named Lighthouse–commonly called a chatbot–for exploring the Civil Rights period of the United States using data from South Carolina. From an AI perspective, the system’s novelty lies in its guiding design principles of (a) focusing on trustworthiness of content and (b) by modeling and reducing potential harm to users from generated answers. It implements these with a neuro-symbolic approach that combines neural learning through a large language model (LLM) with rule-based symbolic solving, balancing risk of answers with generality of coverage. We evaluate Lighthouse with both factual objective questions that admit a single acceptable answer as well as subjective questions. For the latter, a dataset of subjective question-answer pairs (QAs) is created by discovering a “gold standard” by aggregating answers from independent experts. Lighthouse has access to over 18k primary sources from a range of collections and can be easily extended.

[NLP-100] baseVultra: Compact Nonlinear Recurrence with Reallocated Capacity

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统循环神经网络中门控机制（gated cell）对计算资源的过度占用问题，特别是针对长短期记忆网络（LSTM）和门控循环单元（GRU）等主流架构在紧凑模型配置下效率与性能之间的权衡。其核心挑战在于：尽管门控结构在序列建模中表现优异，但其复杂的门控矩阵计算消耗了大量参数与算力，限制了模型在轻量级场景下的可扩展性。为此，作者提出baseVultra这一紧凑型循环单元，其关键创新在于将递归计算预算从传统的门控变换重构至候选生成阶段——通过仅保留一个H×H的密集候选生成矩阵作为主要递归路径，而将原本由门控矩阵承担的递归作用替换为O(H)规模的对角交互项，从而显著降低计算开销。同时，该架构引入低秩辅助分支、指数移动平均（EMA）缓存及可学习输出融合机制，并通过轻量级二阶信息访问历史状态（h_t-2），实现高效且精准的状态更新。实验表明，在小型数据集如TinyShakespeare上，baseVultra以约54%的密集矩阵乘法量达到优于匹配参数量LSTM与GRU的验证损失；在更大规模文本8（text8）任务中，其性能接近全门控细胞；而在形式语言探测任务中，其优势在隐状态容量受限时尤为明显，随着隐藏维度增大则逐渐消失。这揭示出：将递归能力集中于候选生成环节的策略在紧凑模型中具有显著优势，而全门控结构在大规模场景下仍具竞争力。

作者: Linke Zhang
机构: Southwest University (西南大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Nonlinear recurrent networks remain useful for streaming sequence modeling, yet gated cell design is still dominated by LSTM and GRU. We study whether recurrent computation can be reallocated away from gate transforms and toward candidate generation. We propose baseVultra, a compact recurrent cell that concentrates the dense recurrent budget on a single H x H candidate-generation matrix, while replacing recurrent gate matrices with O(H) diagonal interactions. The candidate update combines this dense branch with two low-rank auxiliary branches, an EMA cache, and learnable output blending; the gates additionally receive lightweight second-order access to h_t-2 through diagonal terms. On TinyShakespeare character-level language modeling, baseVultra achieves a validation loss of 1.594 in the compact one-layer 200K setting, compared with 1.604 for a parameter-matched LSTM and 1.616 for a parameter-matched GRU, while its dense recurrent matrix-vector computation is about 54% of GRU under matched hidden size for this configuration. On text8, a roughly 45x larger benchmark, baseVultra is competitive with full-gate cells (1.854 bpc vs. 1.849 for GRU and 1.837 for LSTM). On formal-language probes, the largest gains appear under constrained hidden-state capacity (0.991 vs. 0.761 GRU and 0.691 LSTM OOD2 accuracy on Counter at H=16) and vanish as hidden size grows. These results characterize where and when candidate-focused recurrent capacity allocation helps: the benefit is concentrated in compact regimes, while full-gate cells remain competitive at scale.

[NLP-101] When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式决策模型在多正确选项场景下概率输出可靠性不足的问题。尽管现有决策模型在单一正确答案任务中表现出良好的校准性，但在存在多个正确选项时，其输出的概率分布仍可能无法准确反映真实选择的合理性。研究发现，即使所有正确选项均被正确排序于干扰项之上，在28%至50%的情况下，仍有至少一个正确选项的概率低于均匀概率（1/n，n为候选数量），表明概率分配存在系统性偏差。此外，当向模型输入五个完全相同的正确选项时，其输出概率差异显著，平均差距达17至79个百分点，暴露了概率输出的不一致性。这些现象导致基于概率阈值的筛选策略无法有效召回所有正确选项。解决方案的关键在于：决策模型的概率输出虽能实现正确选项的相对排序，但不能依赖单一概率阈值来识别完整的正确选项集合，必须重新审视概率解释逻辑与多答案场景下的评估范式。

Abstract:Decision models return normalized probability distributions over candidate choices, which downstream applications can use to select among choices. Although their providers emphasize the reliability of these probabilities, calibration on tasks with a single correct choice does not establish their reliability when multiple choices are correct. We evaluate three decision models (Jev, Liquid d1, and GPT-6 Luna Decisions) on three diverse datasets (MetaTool, HotpotQA, and ECtHR) to study probability allocation and thresholding. Even when models rank every correct choice above every distractor, in 28% to 50% of those lists, at least one correct choice receives a probability below the uniform probability of 1/n, where n is the number of choices. We also present each model with five identical copies of a correct choice and observe probability disparities, with mean gaps ranging from 17 to 79 percentage points. We further show how these allocation disparities affect the recovery of multiple correct choices under probability thresholding. Decision-model probabilities can rank correct choices, but a probability threshold does not identify the set of correct choices.

Abstract:Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated transformative potential across diverse fields. However, in computer-aided synthesis planning (CASP), current LLM methodologies are often restricted to single-molecule representations, limiting their application to isolated, single-task scenarios such as precursor prediction. Addressing this gap, we present ChemBART, a BART-based language model that adopts a reaction-centric pre-training strategy. By leveraging a mask-filling pre-training task on holistic reaction expressions (Reactant Reagent Product), ChemBART effectively solves a variety of chemical problems, including precursor/reagent generation, temperature-yield regression, and molecular property classification. Building on these capabilities, we demonstrate the integration of ChemBART with Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) for multi-step synthesis route design, where the model serves to optimize the policy and value functions within a reinforcement learning framework. Beyond single-molecule pre-trained LLMs that are constrained to specific applications, ChemBART unifies diverse chemical tasks to facilitate synthesis planning with comprehensive implementation information. Most significantly, the proposed multi-step synthesis routes and reaction conditions were validated in the wet lab, confirming the discovery of shorter synthetic pathways with a 20% yield improvement over established literature benchmarks. Our work highlights the potential of reaction-focused pre-training and showcases the broad utility of ChemBART in closing the loop between in silico prediction and wet-lab synthesis.

Abstract:Mental health applications have emerged as a critical area in computational health, driven by rising global rates of mental illness, the integration of AI in psychological care, and the need for scalable solutions in underserved communities. These include therapy chatbots, crisis detection, and wellness platforms handling sensitive data, requiring specialized AI safety beyond general safeguards due to emotional vulnerability, risks like misdiagnosis or symptom exacerbation, and precise management of vulnerable states to avoid severe outcomes such as self-harm or loss of trust. Despite AI safety advances, general safeguards inadequately address mental health-specific challenges, including crisis intervention accuracy to avert escalations, therapeutic guideline adherence to prevent misinformation, scale limitations in resource-constrained settings, and adaptation to nuanced dialogues where generics may introduce biases or miss distress signals. We introduce an approach to apply Constitutional AI training with domain-specific mental health principles for safe, domain-adapted CAI systems in computational mental health applications.

Abstract:Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.

Abstract:Most automated survey generation systems retrieve papers as flat documents, limiting their ability to capture research structure. Human adjudication of 108 stratified semantic edges finds 68.5% supported-or-partial relations (binary-support Cohen’s kappa = 0.64), with improves strongest (80.6%) and extends weakest (52.8%). A SurveyBench-facing collection probe reaches mean reference coverage of 0.521 across four topics with an eight-paper budget. Abstract:Review-oriented workflows have become the dominant approach to AI-assisted document review in electronic discovery (eDiscovery). How to validate the effectiveness of review-oriented workflows has, however, remained a confusing and controversial topic in technology-assisted review (TAR) in the law. We examine the sources of this controversy, and propose a simple and practical evaluation approach for review-oriented workflows. Our Delayed Countdown method is easily incorporated into existing review-oriented workflows and software, is compatible with arbitrary stopping rules, and produces valid frequentist confidence intervals on effectiveness. We explain the conceptual foundations of the method, provide example computations, discuss the handling of logically impossible recall values, and suggest future work on decreasing review costs.

Abstract:Chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation are almost always evaluated on a static snapshot, yet the documents underlying a knowledge base continue to change. Because chunks are embedded independently, a boundary that moves after an edit forces unchanged text to be re-embedded. We measure this update cost on 120 pairs of adjacent Chinese and English Wikipedia revisions for three stateless chunkers (non-overlapping fixed-size, recursive paragraph-first, and content-defined chunking) under a strict byte-identical reuse rule and a frozen dense encoder. On the 116-article common-success pool, with frozen, length-calibrated parameters, fixed-size chunking recomputes 57-68% of its full new-version embedding-input workload, recursive chunking 38-56%, and content-defined chunking 43-54% (it failed on 4 of 62 Chinese articles), while at these parameters mean evidence recall under a fixed 2048-token retrieval budget differs by less than two percentage points within either language. A cost-only parameter grid shows that the ranking of the two content-aware chunkers changes with chunk-length settings, whereas non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched condition. Controlled edits and a verbatim-presence diagnostic support boundary drift as one contributor to recomputation of text already present in the previous version. Update cost is therefore a substantial, parameter-sensitive dimension that static retrieval evaluations do not expose and that should be reported alongside retrieval quality.

Abstract:Formalized mathematics libraries such as Lean’s \textttmathlib provide machine-verifiable representations of mathematical knowledge, including definitions, theorems, and their relationships. Abstract:General-purpose embeddings trained on profile similarity often misrank candidates in professional networks, where relevance is inherently complementary rather than symmetric. For example, job seekers usually engage with recruiters rather than peers with similar credentials. Current user recommendation systems are often built on profile similarity or social signals such as shared connections, which are effective in friend-oriented social networks where users tend to connect with similar people or within existing social circles. However, this does not hold in professional platforms like LinkedIn, where interactions are often goal-driven and cross-role interactions, requiring matching based on complementary intents rather than similarity or social proximity. In this paper, we propose Preference-Aligned Intent Retrieval, a retrieval framework that is designed to model user intent preference instead of profile similarity. Our approach is inspired by the preference-learning perspective of Direct Preference Optimization, but instantiates preference learning as an exposure-conditioned multi-negative contrastive objective over embeddings. This formulation simplifies training and scales efficiently to large candidate sets without requiring an explicit reference model. Furthermore, we incorporate user interaction history by aggregating click histories with positional encoding to capture temporal order, which enables constant-cost updates of user representations over a fixed history window, allowing new interactions to be incorporated without re-encoding history. As a result, personalization can be updated efficiently using lightweight CPU operations without repeated LLM inference during serving. We evaluate PAIR on LinkedIn’s Premium retrieval task. A 0.6B parameter model achieves a MAR@100 of 0.45.

Abstract:Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Abstract:Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to alleviate data sparsity and cold-start problems by transferring useful preference knowledge across domains. To address these challenges, we propose BGAFlow, a personalized framework that combines state-adaptive semantic evolution with user-specific transfer control. To enable semantic adaptation, BGAFlow constructs a conditional Bezier curve as a geometric reference and learns a residual flow that progressively refines the trajectory based on intermediate preference states. The learned flow incorporates dynamic preference feedback to adjust transfer directions, while recommendation supervision and trajectory regularization encourage effective and smooth adaptation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that BGAFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the benefits of personalized transfer control and state-adaptive semantic evolution.

Abstract:Nearest-neighbor search over embedding vectors matches faces against watchlists, transactions against known fraud patterns, and medical images against confirmed cases, where a missed neighbor is a missed threat, fraud, or diagnosis. Because an approximate index cannot report which queries lost a true neighbor, these applications require recall of 0.999 to 0.9999, at a cost far below that of exact search over billions of vectors. Inverted-file indexes reach high recall by probing more lists, but they read and score every probed vector at full precision, so that throughput falls in inverse proportion to the number of probed lists. Graph indexes saturate below these targets, whereas quantized lists must rerank their candidates with the full vectors. Our insight is to decide for almost every probed vector that it cannot enter the top k of the probed lists without reading the vector, through the certified lower bound of exact search by certified exclusion. This paper turns this insight into Lychee, a GPU inverted-file search that screens the probed lists on tensor cores under a threshold from anchors of the same lists and computes exact distances only for the few survivors. We prove that Lychee returns exactly the k nearest vectors of the probed lists, the answer of an inverted-file search at full precision, while it reads a few hundred full vectors per query regardless of the number of probed lists. On eleven datasets from one million to one billion vectors and against ten GPU and CPU baselines, Lychee is 9.7 to 117 times faster than IVF-Flat at equal recall with 200 probed lists on datasets of up to 100 million vectors. It also reaches recall levels that CAGRA and HNSW do not reach and outruns exact search by certified exclusion by 5 to 18 times above ten million vectors. On four GPUs, Lychee searches one billion vectors at recall 0.9999, 44.5 times faster than IVF-Flat on BIGANN-1B.

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Abstract:Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Abstract:Generative AI is widely framed as democratizing skilled work by lowering the barrier to producing professional output. In participants’ accounts, drafting was rarely the hard part. The consequential work was making AI-assisted drafts defensible enough to circulate to clients. We identify five intertwined practices through which participants made generative AI workable: using it as draft labour, steering outputs through iterative interaction, switching and comparing across tools, performing release work to make outputs accountable before circulation, and repairing context misfit when outputs failed local requirements. We make two central contributions. First, we specify release work as a distinct, boundary-facing form of accountability labour, evidenced through verification gates, traceability reconstruction when sources fail, and non-delegation boundaries that decide what can ship. Second, we show how localization and representational failures, which we call context misfit, operate in everyday work as a recurring breakdown-and-repair class, including failures of local language, institutional knowledge, and the credible representation of African people and places, and we document the repair repertoire they demanded. Reframing democratization as workable participation, we argue that reported gains were conditional on this accountability and repair labour, and we translate the findings into four design directions for workplace generative AI. We treat Kenya and Nigeria as two situated cases, not as a representative sample of SMBs or the Global South.

In an exploratory user study, compared to a standard LLM baseline, authors using CoWriter better expressed their perspectives and maintained a higher sense of document ownership, supported quantitatively by 2.2\times more successful agent engagements. Overall, our results demonstrate that proactively engaging users through established human practices is beneficial for effective LLM-supported co-authoring, providing useful methodologies, techniques and insights for future research on collaborative agents.

Abstract:This chapter explores how robotic systems and ambient intelligence can enhance care for older adults in residential aged care (RAC) homes and private homes. We review embodied and non-embodied systems that assist with daily living, safety monitoring, and social engagement, highlighting hybrid deployments where robots complement fixed and wearable sensors. Interaction design prioritises accessibility for older adults with low digital literacy, using robust but simple voice interfaces, small sets of non-verbal cues, accessible screen-based companions, and safe object handovers. Abstract:An important task of uncertainty visualizations is to communicate how the number of available observations influences the precision of estimates, such as a Normal distribution’s mean. Abstract:Failure of applied Reinforcement Learning (RL) to solve a given problem predominantly stems from unaddressed specification gaps, where the intent of human experts in the problem’s domain is inaccurately or incompletely translated by AI into mathematical objectives, constraints, and reward functions. Failure can also stem from unaddressed performance gaps, where human domain experts are unable to determine the validity of the RL based solution or where parameters (i.e., hyperparameters or weights on the reward terms comprising the reward) are poorly chosen. Chat Assisted Reinforcement Learning (CARL) bridges these gaps through a human-AI co-design interface architecture that enforces interactive specification prior to code generation and then enables subsequent verification and parameter alterations via iteration. More specifically, CARL leads domain experts through a structured ten-step workflow for each iteration using step-specific skill files, domain-aware suggestions via an assistant persona (called Trillian), and compact decision summaries that maintain context across iterations without context overload. Once the domain expert confirms the Markov decision process (MDP) specified by this procedure, CARL’s autonomous tool-use loop generates, tests, executes, and debugs an end-to-end RL training pipeline, followed by an interactive post-training diagnosis and revisit step that allows for verification and parameter alteration before running a new iteration if desired.

Abstract:Generative AI imposes new metacognitive demands on knowledge workers as their work shifts from production to planning, evaluation, and orchestration. Abstract:Everyday household information is often exchanged in conversations but never written down, making details easy to forget or misremember. Abstract:AI assistants built on large language models (LLMs) are trained on human feedback and increasingly personalized to users’ stated preferences. Whether stated priorities matched ratings depended on how attributes were measured: participants who prioritized an attribute favoured responses from models that others perceived as strong on it, but not responses that scored higher on text proxies for it. Participants also differed stably in how much they weighted several concrete features, especially length, but with a median of 6 conversations per participant, these weights were estimated poorly. The largest gain from personal information in predicting held-out choices was 0.13 percentage points, compared with 1.11 for a stronger pooled model. Abstract:Digitally mediated attachment is increasingly common, yet the mechanisms of symbolic closure in hybrid physical–digital relationships remain underexplored. Abstract:Traversability estimation is critical for ground vehicle teleoperation, yet existing methods often neglect the human operator’s preferences for speed and risk tolerance. Abstract:Understanding how university students perceive the development of their generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) skills over time can clarify how GenAI use relates to learning and academic outcomes. Abstract:As AI increasingly becomes a collaborator in scientific research, its impact may extend beyond improving ideas to reshaping how they are evaluated, attributed, and perceived by humans. Yet existing research has largely examined these dimensions in isolation. We present a unified empirical study of Human-AI scientific ideation, investigating two complementary perspectives: i) how AI collaboration shapes scientific ideas and their evaluation, and ii) how firsthand collaboration reshapes human perceptions of AI. Through a shared experimental setting involving Human-AI and Human-Human research teams, human and LLM evaluators, collaboration-provenance analysis, and participant surveys, we uncover several counterintuitive findings. First, AI collaboration shows no significant advantage in human-evaluated idea quality, while iterative revision consistently improves quality. Second, AI judges can approximate human scores yet disagree on idea rankings; notably, an AI judge favors AI-assisted proposals without a corresponding advantage in human evaluations. Third, collaboration provenance remains only partially detectable, revealing substantial overlap between Human-AI and Human-Human scientific outputs. Finally, firsthand AI collaboration is associated with greater perceived usefulness but smaller efficiency gains than expected, suggesting a nuanced recalibration of human expectations. Overall, our findings challenge the notion that AI’s value in scientific ideation lies primarily in producing better ideas, revealing instead its broader influence on scientific creation, evaluation, attribution, and human perceptions.

Abstract:While traditional cinematic viewing is often characterized as a social experience, engaging with immersive stories is predominantly researched as an individual activity. To address our limited understanding of these effects, we conducted three exploratory experiments (N _1 =109, N _2 =116, N _3 =88) examining how spatial boundary type, size of allocated personal space, and group familiarity influence co-watching 360-degree stories in social VR. Results shows that small communal spatial boundaries heightened social presence towards others compared to individual boundaries, but also increased mental demand. Reducing the size of the personal spatial boundary increased social presence towards others but also increased disorientation and frustration. Finally, participants with higher group familiarity reported stronger attentional focus on the story, as well as higher spatial presence and social presence towards story characters, but also reported greater physical and perceptual demand. We discuss systematic tradeoffs between engagement and cognitive effort, and suggest practical guidelines for designing shared immersive narrative experiences.

Abstract:Reliance on AI describes the behavioral patterns of when and how individuals depend on AI suggestions, and appropriate reliance patterns are necessary to achieve effective human-AI collaboration. Traditional measures often link reliance to decision-making outcomes, which may not be suitable for complex problem-solving tasks where outcomes are not binary (i.e., correct or incorrect) or immediately clear. Therefore, this study aims to develop a scale to measure undergraduate students’ behaviors of using Generative AI during problem-solving tasks without directly linking them to specific outcomes. We conducted an exploratory factor analysis on 800 responses collected after students finished one problem-solving activity, which revealed four distinct factors: reflective use, cautious use, thoughtless use, and collaborative use. The overall scale has reached sufficient internal reliability (Cronbach’s alpha = .84). Two confirmatory factor analyses (CFAs) were conducted to validate the factors using the remaining 730 responses from this activity and 1,173 responses from another problem-solving activity. CFA indices showed adequate model fit for data from both problem-solving tasks, suggesting that the scale can be applied to various human-AI problem-solving tasks. This study offers a validated scale to measure students’ reliance behaviors in different human-AI problem-solving activities and provides implications for educators to responsively integrate Generative AI in higher education.

[HC-26] he EU AI Act Beyond Europe: A Practical Readiness Framework for Non-EU Organisations. Comparative Evidence from Four African Countries

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30152
作者: Uloma Okoro,Branislav Radeljic
类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Systems and Control (eess.SY)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The EU Artificial Intelligence Act has implications for organizations within Europe as well as organisations outside the European Union where they provide AI-enabled services to EU clients, use European vendors, participate in EU-facing supply chains, or generate outputs that are used in the EU. This study examines the implications of these impacts for African countries and other non-EU organisations, using South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya and Egypt as comparative cases. It applies doctrinal legal analysis, structured document review and scenario-based comparison to assess the sufficiency or otherwise of existing regulatory frameworks within the selected countries. The analysis shows that the existing regulatory frameworks (like data-protection, financial-sector, cybersecurity and corporate-governance rules) can support AI readiness, but they do not resolve questions of territorial scope, role classification, risk categorisation, vendor responsibility and access to compliance evidence. The analysis proposes a seven-step readiness framework which covers exposure mapping, AI inventories, role and risk classification, governance, contracts, evidence management and continuous monitoring. It argues for proportionate, interoperable approaches that enable non-EU organisations to demonstrate readiness without treating EU compliance as a uniform exercise.

Abstract:Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. [CV-1] Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success

作者: Yunfei Xie,Howard H. Qian,Shiyi Lan,Kaiyu Hang,Chen Wei
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注: 28 pages. Project page and code available at this https URL

Abstract:Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ( S^2 ), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model’s sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that S^2 correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. S^2 can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, S^2 offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With S^2 , we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

[CV-2] Reading Writing Sharing and Interacting with the World through Video

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31668
作者: Shengqiong Wu,Meng Luo,Bobo Li,Ziwei Liu,Shuicheng Yan,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Philip Torr,Hao Fei
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: 102 pages, 17 figures, 19 tables. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

Abstract:Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training images. Proactive dataset-use auditing plants a shared signal in a dataset before release, then later checks whether that signal appears in a suspect model’s generated outputs. Existing approaches often trade off verifiability, fidelity, robustness, and deployability. We introduce \textbfSpectralCanary , which uses a smooth low-pass mask to blend a fixed canary image into every collection image while leaving captions unchanged and requiring neither auxiliary generation nor per-image optimization. A lightweight verifier detects the transferred signal in suspect-model outputs. Across eight tests on the Pokemon dataset and three realistic data transformations, spanning two architectures families, SpectralCanary achieves the highest average per-generation TPR@ 1% FPR ( 91.1% ) and fixed threshold model-level accuracy using 30 generations ( 94.8% ) among the evaluated methods. Across five datasets spanning artistic, medical, satellite, and fashion domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary averages 92.4% per-generation TPR@ 1% FPR while preserving the released images (SSIM 0.989 , LPIPS 0.022 ) with a near-zero mean change FID (mean \Delta FID 0.05 ) across datasets. Matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 support our design choice, low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Under the evaluated adaptive attacks, the most effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than 25 \Delta FID points. These results identify low-frequency visual signals as effective carriers for collection-level T2I audit traces.

Abstract:Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. Focusing on the domain of LEGO brick builds, we present BrickWright, a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds from text or image prompts using pre-trained agents, where a build is physically feasible if it uses only real parts, has no colliding or floating parts, and forms a connected structure if possible. Whereas baseline agents achieve physical validity rates ranging from only 9% (GPT-6 Luna) to 69% (GPT-6 Astra), BrickWright-guided agents achieve 100% validity on a sample of 512 prompts, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight agents and maintaining it for stronger agents. Abstract:Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. A degradation-aware router bypasses inputs classified as clean and extracts features to guide purification of the remaining inputs. Conditioned on these features, a 3D-oriented one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity, contours, and textural cues. Abstract:Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.

Abstract:Learnable Representations (LRs) can fit parametric families of functions to diverse kinds of signals. These emergent neural-native data formats are gathering interest in the scientific community due to their compactness, resolution-agnosticism and amenability to direct neural processing. On the other hand, gigapixel images are becoming increasingly widespread across a variety of scientific, cultural, and industrial domains. In this paper, we present GigaBench, the first benchmark and experimental evaluation focused on deploying LRs with gigapixel imagery. GigaBench includes images collected, acquired, and synthetically rendered across diverse domains, and addresses image compression and super-resolution. Abstract:Video object removal and injection are reciprocal editing operations between object-present and object-absent video states, yet they differ substantially in training difficulty. Removal can be effectively bootstrapped from video inpainting and further adapted to erase object-related interaction effects. Injection, however, requires large-scale paired supervision to model object appearance, dynamics, and scene-dependent effects, while perfectly aligned real-world pairs are difficult to collect and synthetic data lacks sufficient realism and diversity. To address this challenge, we present UniVOE, a removal-driven framework for training both video object removal and injection models. We first train an effect-aware remover by transferring video inpainting priors and finetuning on object-present/object-absent pairs. The trained remover converts real object-present videos into object-absent counterparts, creating large-scale paired supervision for injection. An injection model is trained on these pairs in the reverse direction to recover objects together with their dynamics and interaction effects. Moreover, since pixel-level reconstruction alone cannot adequately capture perceptual realism, we introduce a reward-based post-training method that aligns injection results with human preferences using a proprietary reward model. Experiments against strong open-source and commercial systems demonstrate that UniVOE achieves state-of-the-art performance on both object removal and injection, particularly in challenging interaction-effect cases.

Abstract:Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and entangled camera motion with scene dynamics. Existing approaches, such as task-specific fine-tuning and post-process warping, often introduce visual artifacts, generalize poorly, or incur high computational costs. We propose WorldForge V2 to achieve accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. We first develop a training-free guidance framework using warped references to iteratively refine generation along a target camera path. Optical-flow analysis identifies motion-related latent channels for selective guidance, helping separate motion control from appearance. A dual-path strategy further compares guided and unguided predictions to correct artifacts from imperfect references. Together, these components guide viewpoint changes while preserving scene appearance and object motion. To reduce refinement costs, v-cache approximates the correction using the preceding denoising prediction, avoiding an additional model evaluation. We further extend motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and introduce Trajectory LoRA, which concentrates adaptation on blocks most responsive to trajectory guidance. A two-stage training strategy teaches these adapters to denoise the states encountered during guided generation, using limited supervision effectively. This enables reliable camera control with very little training data, with a single training scene already supporting generalization to unseen scenes. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.

[CV-10] HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction

Abstract:Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level \mathrmSim(3) graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared \mathrmSE(3) camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at this https URL.

Abstract:This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object’s 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. 作者: Merve Kocabas,Benjamin A. Burns,Andreas Geiger,Kent Gauen,Sara Fridovich-Keil
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion models have become strong priors for solving inverse problems. However, nonlinear inverse problems such as phase retrieval remain challenging when multiple measurement-consistent solutions are distinguishable only by the prior; we call such measurements ambiguous. Existing diffusion-based samplers rely on local approximations during reconstruction. For an ambiguous measurement, these approximations can allow measurement guidance to favor a measurement-consistent mode that is close to a prior-supported mode but is itself not supported by the prior. Evaluation often masks this type of failure by reporting the best-of- k runs, where the best is selected by comparison to the ground truth. We introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), a variant of Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS) designed to address this failure case by maintaining multiple candidate solutions within a single sampling run. As annealing noise decreases, PC-DAPS prunes and replaces weaker candidates according to their prior consistency, without any ground-truth access. PC-DAPS reduces the incidence of prior-inconsistent samples and improves sample quality on nonlinear inverse problems while preserving sample quality and diversity on linear inverse problems.
